title: GTM(Go-To-Market Strategy) Engineer
description:
### **About the Role**

At Techdome, growth is a system we build, not a campaign we run once. As our GTM Engineer, you will design and operate that system: figuring out which customers matter most, shaping how we talk to them, picking the channels where they actually pay attention, and turning ad spend into a predictable stream of qualified leads and revenue.

Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) will be your primary playground, alongside Google, LinkedIn, and emerging channels. You will own budgets, measure outcomes, and keep refining what works. If you like owning outcomes, thinking in numbers, and building growth engines from scratch, this role is for you.

### **What You Will Do**

### **Go-To-Market Strategy**

* Define Techdome’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and pinpoint the segments with the highest potential.
* Craft sharp positioning and messaging for each product and service.
* Select the right channel mix for every offering.
* Lead launches end to end, from planning through live campaigns.
* Partner with design, product, and sales so our story stays consistent everywhere.

### **Paid Advertising**

* Own Meta Ads from start to finish: audiences, creative testing, bidding, and scaling.
* Plan, launch, and scale campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, and new platforms.
* Manage ad budgets and make sure every rupee is working hard.
* Build and refine the full funnel, from first touch to closed deal.

### **Tracking & Analytics**

* Set up and maintain tracking: pixels, Conversions API, event tagging, and UTM structures.
* Monitor CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS using GA4 and other analytics tools.
* Run A/B tests across ads, landing pages, messaging, and audiences, and document the learnings.
* Keep CRM data clean and report performance clearly to the team.

### **AI & Automation**

* Use AI tools to accelerate ad copy, creative production, campaign optimization, and reporting.

### **What You Bring**

* 1.5+ years in digital or performance marketing.
* Strong hands-on experience running Meta Ads.
* Track record of scaling campaigns across more than one ad platform.
* Experience building or executing go-to-market plans, including positioning, segmentation, and launches.
* Comfort owning a budget and being accountable for results.
* Solid grasp of funnels, audience segmentation, and retargeting.
* Working knowledge of GA4 and CRM or marketing automation tools.
* Familiarity with AI marketing tools such as copywriting assistants and creative generators.
* Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills.
* Clear communication and sharp analytical thinking.
* A proactive mindset and genuine excitement about building from zero.

### **Nice to Have**

* Basic SQL.
* Experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar product analytics tools.
* Background in product positioning, pricing, or marketing automation.
* Interest in AI-driven marketing analytics or predictive modeling.

### **Why Join Techdome?**

* **Real ownership:** Run GTM strategy and campaigns that directly move company revenue.
* **Autonomy from day one:** Make decisions without waiting for layers of approval.
* **Cross-team collaboration:** Work side by side with product, sales, and design.
* **Open culture:** A flat team where new ideas are welcome and learning is fast.
* **Career growth:** A clear path to senior GTM or marketing leadership.

title: Cloud Operations Intern
description:
Overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious Cloud Operations(SRE) Intern to join our CloudOps team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in day-to-day cloud operations, monitoring and incident triage, infrastructure automation and CI/CD, cloud cost management (FinOps), security and compliance, and AI-assisted operations while collaborating with experienced cloud engineers, and application development teams.  
Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the platform end to end, connect application and business needs to reliable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud operations, evaluate state-of-the-art automation approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and agentic operations solutions.

Responsibilities:

* Understand the platform architecture (mainly AWS, with some Azure), the multi-account setup across production and non-production environments, service dependencies, deployment workflows, and the main reliability, security, and cost risks.
* Assist with day-to-day cloud operations, including environment health checks, configuration reviews, access requests, backups, and resource inventory, starting in non-production environments under guidance.
* Build and maintain monitoring for cloud services, including CloudWatch metrics, log-based metric filters, alarms, and dashboards, and help tune thresholds to reduce alert noise.
* Participate in incident investigation and log triage; query logs and metrics with tools such as CloudWatch Logs Insights, reproduce issues, support root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and turn findings into runbooks and triage playbooks.
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code (AWS CloudFormation, Terraform) and Python or Typescript automation for repeatable operational tasks, following peer review and change-management practices.
* Support Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure; analyze pipeline results, build logs, and agent failures, and help keep controllers and agents healthy and current.
* Contribute to FinOps work across AWS and Azure, such as cost reporting and dashboards, tagging hygiene, finding idle or unused resources, rightsizing, and Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage reviews.
* Support security and compliance work, including IAM least-privilege reviews, key and secret hygiene, audit evidence collection, and control mapping for SOC 2 and FedRAMP.
* Prototype AI-assisted operations using LLMs, Generative AI, and AI agents for activities such as alarm and ticket triage, log summarization, incident analysis, cost anomaly explanation, and runbook maintenance.
* Contribute to the team’s Amazon Bedrock CloudOps prototype, an agentic AI assistant that plans read-only investigations, queries logs, metrics, and platform data through approved tools, uses the team’s playbooks as a knowledge base, and reports findings, with PII masking, guardrails, and human review built in.
* Measure monitoring and automation effectiveness by tracking alert noise, time to detect and resolve incidents, automation coverage, and cost savings, and recommend practical improvements.
* Learn and apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework, SRE principles such as toil reduction, the FinOps lifecycle, and secure operations practices.

Required Qualifications  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, identity and access management, and virtual networks, along with Linux and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing).
* Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, TypeScript.
* Foundational understanding of source control (Git), CI/CD concepts, APIs, JSON and YAML, SQL, and ticketing tools such as Jira.
* Essential exposure to and conceptual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI, including their practical use in software engineering or IT operations.
* Ability to understand a system end to end, troubleshoot methodically from symptom to cause, learn unfamiliar technologies, and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment and learn, with care and discipline around production systems.

title: AI Test Engineer
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

We are looking for an AI Test Engineer who combines strong software quality assurance and test automation experience with hands-on expertise in AI-assisted testing. The role involves using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and Figma designs to generate test scenarios and executable automated tests using AI tools.

The ideal candidate can effectively provide the right context to AI tools, validate AI-generated outputs, and continuously improve test development workflows to accelerate automation while ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, traceability, and maintainability.

#### **What you will do**

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions to translate user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX specifications such as Figma designs into test scenarios and executable automated tests.
* Build and improve AI-assisted testing workflows where requirements and design artifacts can be provided as context and used to generate, update, and expand automated tests with minimal manual scripting.
* Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to provide AI tools with requirements, application context, coding standards, existing automation frameworks, and relevant design information so that generated tests are accurate and maintainable.
* Review, validate, debug, and refine AI-generated test scenarios and automation code rather than accepting generated output without verification.
* Identify opportunities to automate the test-development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, test generation, test-data creation, regression maintenance, failure analysis, and coverage expansion.

#### **What you bring**

*Experience*

* 5–8 years of experience in software QA
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding or engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools for software testing and test automation.
* Experience using requirements such as user stories, acceptance criteria, and UI/UX designs as context for AI-assisted generation of test scenarios and automated tests.
* Experience creating or configuring AI-assisted workflows that can transform requirements into executable automation, rather than using AI only for ad-hoc code completion or general-purpose prompting.
* Ability to provide application-specific context to AI tools, including existing automation code, framework conventions, requirements, design information, and test data, to improve generated test quality.
* Practical understanding of validating AI-generated tests for correctness, coverage, maintainability, traceability to requirements, and potential hallucinations or incorrect assumptions.

***Personal competencies***

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and a risk-based approach to quality assurance.
* Curiosity and a proactive mindset when exploring complex workflows and edge cases.
* Willingness to adopt AI-assisted tools to improve productivity and test coverage.
* Effective communication and collaboration across technical and clinical teams.
* Ownership of testing outcomes, defect resolution, and release quality.

#### **Who we are**

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

title: Jr. Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for passionate and experienced **Agentic AI Engineers** across Junior, Senior, and Lead levels to design, develop, and deploy next-generation AI agents using **GitHub Copilot Agent SDK**, **Microsoft Agent Framework**, and **Python**. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in building autonomous and multi-agent systems, integrating LLMs, implementing Agentic AI workflows, and delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions.

The role involves architecting intelligent agents, enabling agent-to-agent collaboration, integrating enterprise tools and data sources, implementing RAG solutions, and deploying scalable AI applications in cloud environments.

**Responsibilities**

* + Design, develop, and deploy AI agents using GitHub Copilot Agent SDK and Microsoft Agent Framework.
  + Build autonomous, multi-agent, and workflow-driven AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
  + Develop agent orchestration, tool-calling, function-calling, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  + Implement memory management, context handling, and agent communication patterns.
  + Design and develop scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.
  + Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and semantic search techniques.
  + Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and external tools.
  + Develop and optimize prompt engineering strategies for improved agent performance.
  + Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI agent deployments.
  + Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve agent performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  + Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, QA, Engineering, and DevOps teams.
  + Contribute to architecture design, technical documentation, and best practices for Agentic AI development.

* + 2.5+ years' experience in software engineering and AI solution development.
  + Strong Python fundamentals.
  + Basic experience with LLMs and AI agent development.
  + API integration and workflow automation experience.
  + Ability to develop and support enterprise AI agents under guidance.

* + Experience with Microsoft AI Foundry, Prompt Flow, and AI model deployment.

  + Experience leading AI projects and mentoring engineering teams (Senior/Lead positions).
  + Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**The Opportunity**

Keyloop is in the middle of an AI-enabled transformation, driven by the AI Empowered Programme — a board-mandated effort to lift AI maturity across our ~80 Product & Engineering teams. Two teams sit at the heart of it: Keystone, which builds the underlying AI capability and technical pathways, and Impost, which enables teams to adopt that capability hands-on.

We're looking for an highly motivated AI Enablement Engineer to join Impost and help our engineering teams put Keystone's AI capability to real, effective use. The primary mode of engagement is through a team's AI Champion — coaching, mentoring, or pairing with them to drive sustained, long-term change. You'll also work directly with teams for shorter periods to help resolve specific technical challenges, or gain the kind of deep, first-hand insight that's only visible from inside a team's day-to-day work and feeding it back into the programme.

  

This is a hands-on software engineering role, not an "engineer who used to code." You'll sit on the frontline of AI-driven development lifecycle innovation at Keyloop — as part of the Impost team, you'll be the first adopter team for Keystone's experimental new solutions, taking ownership of real internal systems as genuine test grounds. You'll contribute directly to Keystone's solutions — sometimes through early feedback on what's rough or missing, sometimes through hands-on contribution and pull requests.  
  
Keyloop itself is a dual-speed technology organization: a large, successful DMS heritage business running on established platforms built up over decades, alongside Fusion — a modern, cloud-native Automotive Retail Platform built on AWS, event-driven domain services. You won't need to master every technology across that estate yourself — each team owns its own stack, and that expertise stays with them. Your focus is AI: helping teams leverage Claude Code, skills, agents, and Keystone's recommended solutions effectively, whatever stack they happen to be working in.

### **What You'll Bring**

Must-have:

* Fluency in AI assisted and agentic software development

* Strong, hands-on engineering background with genuine credibility pairing and mentoring other engineers on real technical problems.

* Comfort mastering new, evolving AI capability early — often ahead of formal documentation or a fixed playbook.

* A genuine interest in, and demonstrated ability to have a strong positive impact on the growth of others — through pairing, mentoring, coaching, or developer advocacy. This role is built around lifting other people up, not working heads-down in isolation; if that's not energizing to you, this isn't the right fit.

* Ability to read a team's context and choose the right mode of engagement (direct vs. through a Champion) rather than applying one approach everywhere.

* Experience working effectively across a distributed, multi-location engineering organisation.

* Based in, or willing to work from, Oulu, Finland or Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

### **What You'll Do**

* Direct & Champion-Mediated Enablement: Provide hands-on technical support, training, and mentoring on Keystone's AI capability — working directly with a team or through its AI Champion, depending on context and champion maturity.

* Champion Development: Build the technical capability of AI Champions so they can scale enablement within their own teams, multiplying Impost's reach beyond what a small central team could do alone.

* Early Adoption ("Dogfooding"): Take ownership of real internal systems — starting with the OEM TTV Dashboard — as the test ground for Keystone's experimental new solutions before they reach any other team. Build with them, break them, and feed what you learn directly back into Keystone's own development, through early feedback or, where appropriate, hands-on contribution and pull requests.

* Field Feedback & Cross-Pollination: Surface what works and what doesn't from real engagements; escalate unresolved technical friction to Keystone; spot effective practices in one team and help spread them to others.

* Triage: Recognise when a team's blocker isn't a technical/AI problem, and surface it to the Enablement Workstream for routing — rather than trying to solve it yourself.

* Community & Advocacy: Stay active in relevant AI communities of practice and forums as a natural part of the job; contribute technical content, demos, or talks as capacity allows.

* AI Landscape & Continuous Learning  
  Proactively track developments in AI tooling and practices internally and externally. Bring relevant insights into the organisation and translate them into actionable enablement opportunities before they are asked for.

### **Nice-to-have:**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

### **Nice to Have**

* A genuine interest in agile ways of working, and how they intersect with AI-driven change. You'll work closely with Agile Coaches on adoption that disrupts both what a team builds with and how a team works — the more fluently you can partner with them across both dimensions, the more effective that adoption becomes.

* Prior experience in a platform, developer-experience, or enablement-focused engineering role.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Manager, Engineering (Commerce)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week**  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services.
* Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments.
* Drive predictable execution while maintaining high standards for software quality, security, scalability, and reliability.
* Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team.
* Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization.
* Use engineering metrics such as cycle time, lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and operational reliability to identify improvement opportunities.

**Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
* Partner with Principal Developers and Architects to evaluate architectural trade-offs and establish technical direction aligned with product and business priorities.
* Establish accountability for engineering quality, including clean code, automated testing, security, system reliability, and maintainability.
* Coach and develop engineers in technical problem-solving, architectural thinking, and engineering best practices, building stronger technical decision-making capabilities across the team.
* Guide technical risk management, complex issue resolution, and root cause analysis, engaging directly when necessary while empowering engineers to own solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health.

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide actionable feedback, and support individual career development.
* Own performance management, goal setting, coaching and development planning
* Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering leaders through mentoring and delegation.
* Lead hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and workforce planning to build strong engineering capabilities.
* Foster psychological safety, constructive technical discussions, and an inclusive team environment.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback and coaching, and address performance gaps promptly and constructively to build a high-performing engineering team.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-team collaboration, and reduced dependency on individual contributors.

**AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across development, testing, documentation, and operational workflows.
* Demonstrate a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic engineering workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate delivery, and improve software quality.
* Encourage teams to experiment with AI tools while maintaining appropriate engineering review, security, privacy, and quality controls.
* Collaborate with technical leaders to evaluate AI integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation opportunities.
* Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption, including improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Build team capabilities through technical learning sessions, experimentation, and practical AI-enabled engineering initiatives.

**Operational Excellence & Production Ownership**

* Ensure services meet established reliability, availability, performance, and security expectations.
* Drive production readiness, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Lead incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring preventive actions are implemented and tracked.
* Improve operational metrics such as Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), incident frequency, and service availability.
* Establish effective CI/CD practices, automated quality gates, and reliable deployment processes.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, technical reviews, and engineering metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Platform, QA, Security, and business stakeholders to align engineering execution with organizational priorities.
* Communicate delivery progress, technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.
* Contribute to engineering strategy, technical roadmap planning, and long-term platform evolution.
* Support cross-team initiatives and influence decisions beyond the immediate team.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing business priorities, engineering investment, team capacity, and operational risk.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers and engineering delivery.
* Strong software development background with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise application development.
* Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions.
* Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and operating cloud-based applications, ideally on AWS or comparable platforms.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, messaging systems, API integrations, and containerized applications.
* Proven experience managing engineering delivery, technical priorities, dependencies, and production responsibilities.
* Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of software engineers while building high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
* Experience establishing engineering standards and improving delivery predictability, software quality, reliability, and operational performance.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering practices, including opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering workflows.
* Ability to partner effectively with Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads to evaluate architectural trade-offs, manage technical risks, and guide sound engineering decisions.
* Ability to communicate technical priorities and trade-offs clearly, build cross-functional alignment, and resolve competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes, balancing people development, technical quality, and business priorities.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**

* Experience leading engineering teams supporting Billing, Payments, Collections, or Commerce platforms.
* Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or in an architecture-focused role, bringing additional depth in technical design and engineering decision-making.
* Experience leading large-scale modernization, platform migration, or technical transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed engineering teams or multiple engineering workstreams.
* Exposure to AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted software development, or emerging agentic AI technologies.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. * **Modernize application foundations**

Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.

Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.

Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

* **Raise the bar for code quality and testing**

Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.

* **Create reusable engineering patterns**

Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.

* **Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution**

Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.

* **Service transformation and architecture judgment**

You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.

* **Production reliability and performance expertise**

You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.

* **Software design and refactoring depth**

You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.

* **Data and integration depth**

You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.

* **Strong testing and code-quality discipline**

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.

* **Principal-level technical leadership**

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.

You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**:

  

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.

### **About the opportunity:**

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.

  

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.

  

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.

### **What you will do:**

* **Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction:** Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* **Build at the frontier - hands-on:** Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* **Engineer AI for production:** Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* **Architect agentic systems at scale:** Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.

* **Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards:** Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape data and retrieval architectures:** Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* **Advise clients and shape opportunities:** Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* **Multiply engineering capability:** Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* **Own outcomes across the full lifecycle:** Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

### **Your technical toolkit:**

**Languages and software engineering**

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.

  

**Models and AI ecosystem**

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.

  

**Agentic AI engineering**

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.

  

**Retrieval and search**

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.

  

**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.

  

**Frameworks**

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.

  

**MLOps and LLMOps**

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.

  

**Data and ML foundations**

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.

### **Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.

title: Support Engineer
description:
Our client is a technology company in the infrastructure-reliability space, helping enterprises keep modern infrastructure, AI workloads and hybrid clouds running reliably. Its customers depend on that reliability, so the support desk that answers them has to be fast and technically sharp.

**Softelite Technologies** is a software development company. You will be employed by Softelite and placed with one of our clients as part of a dedicated 24/7 support team.

**Key responsibilities**

* Monitor the Zendesk queue and answer inbound support calls; give every ticket or call a first response within 15 minutes.
* Triage each issue by severity and impact, and collect the details needed to act: logs, timestamps, affected cluster, node or VM.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes issues with kubectl: pod and node status, events, logs, restarts, and failures such as CrashLoopBackOff, Pending and ImagePullBackOff.
* Troubleshoot virtual machines and Linux hosts: connectivity, disk, CPU, memory, services and log review.
* Resolve known issues using runbooks and the knowledge base, and follow documented procedures exactly.
* Escalate to L2/L3 with a complete summary (symptoms, steps tried, evidence) when an issue is beyond runbook scope.
* Keep customers updated in Zendesk and on calls until the issue is resolved or handed off.
* Write clear shift-handover notes so the next shift picks up open tickets without gaps.
* Flag SLA risks, repeat incidents and knowledge-base gaps to the team lead.

**Must-have skills**

Candidates without hands-on Kubernetes, VM and Linux experience will not be considered.

**Kubernetes**

Use kubectl to get, describe and read logs for pods, deployments, services and nodes; read cluster events; spot why a pod is failing; restart or scale a workload under a runbook; know namespaces, ConfigMaps and Secrets

**Virtual machines**

Check VM state, start, stop and reboot, reach the console or SSH, and diagnose network, disk and resource problems on VMware, KVM or cloud VMs (AWS, Azure or GCP)

**Linux commands**

Work fluently in the shell: ls, cd, cat, grep, awk, sed, tail, find, ps, top, df, du, free, ss or netstat, systemctl, journalctl, chmod, chown, ssh, curl, ping, dig, traceroute

**Ticketing and calls**

Work a queue in Zendesk or a similar tool, write clear updates, and handle live customer calls calmly

**Communication**

Fluent spoken and written English

**Good-to-have skills and qualifications**

* Docker and Helm; basic CI/CD awareness
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog
* Basic networking: DNS, TCP/IP, load balancers, firewalls
* Bash or Python scripting for routine checks
* Certifications: CKA, CKAD, RHCSA, AWS Cloud Practitioner or Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL foundation and incident-management experience
* Exposure to AI or GPU workloads

**Education:** Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What we look for in a person:** calm under pressure, disciplined about SLAs, a clear communicator on calls and in writing, willing to follow runbooks, and honest about when to escalate.

**Shift and working model**

The support desk runs 24/7, covered by a team of eight. Each engineer works one shift at a time (about 9 hours, 5 days a week) on a rotation, with rotational weekly offs. Candidates must be comfortable with night and weekend shifts and must be reachable and online from the first minute of every shift, because of the 15-minute response SLA.

Pay: ₹352,000.00 - ₹680,000.00 per year

Shift availability:

* Overnight Shift (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior AI Engineer - Agentic AI and Voice Agents
description:
**Role overview**

We are hiring a senior AI engineer to build and lead agentic AI systems: LLM agents that plan, call tools

and complete real business tasks end to end. You will build agents that hold live phone and web

conversations — streaming speech recognition, reasoning and tool calls, and speech synthesis in real

time. You will stay hands-on while setting technical direction, owning the evaluation system that proves

each agent works before every release, and helping a team of AI engineers move use cases from a demo

to a reliable, observable service that clients trust with their customers.

**Key responsibilities**

**Agentic systems**

* Design and build LLM agents that plan, call tools and complete multi-step business tasks across

voice, chat and back-office channels.

* Implement task and conversation state, memory and context management, retrieval (RAG) and

model routing between fast and more capable models.

* Define tool schemas and permissions, validate every tool call, and add human approval points

for high-impact actions.

* Build durable workflows with checkpoints, retries, idempotency keys, timeouts and

compensation for failed actions.

* Use multi-agent designs, such as a router with specialist agents, only where they measurably

beat a single agent.

* Integrate CRMs, ticketing systems and databases for actions such as complaint registration,

classification, routing, status updates and notifications, with warm human handoff.

**Voice agents**

* Build streaming pipelines that connect telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) and WebRTC audio to ASR,

LLMs and TTS over WebSockets.

* Implement voice activity detection, turn detection, barge-in and cancellation so the agent stops

talking the moment a caller speaks.

* Set and hold latency budgets per hop (ASR, LLM, TTS, network), with a target of under [1 s] from

end of caller speech to first agent audio.

* Adapt agent behaviour for speech: short turns, confirmations before actions, and recovery from

mishearing.

* Support multilingual and code-switched calls, including language detection and matching TTS

voices.

**Evaluation**

* Build and maintain golden test sets that define the user goal, persona, expected tool calls and

pass criteria for each scenario.

* Run trajectory evals that check each step, tool choice, arguments and order, not just the final

answer.

* Run simulated-caller evals for voice: an LLM plays the caller, TTS voices it with accents, noise

and interruptions, and the agent is tested end to end over real audio.

* Score task success, tool-call correctness, policy compliance, hallucination, word error rate and

latency, using rule checks and LLM judges calibrated against human ratings.

* Gate releases in CI on eval results, block regressions, and turn every confirmed production

failure into a new test case.

**Backend and operations**

* Write async Python services (FastAPI, asyncio) with structured logging, tracing and metrics for

every agent run and conversation.

* Load-test concurrent sessions, find bottlenecks and keep p95 latency and per-task model cost

within budget.

* Protect sensitive data: authentication and authorisation, audit trails for agent actions, PII

redaction and tenant isolation.

* Ship with Docker and CI using staged releases and rollback, and troubleshoot live agents in

production.

* Work with product and delivery teams to turn client workflows into working agent integrations.

**Technical leadership**

* Own the architecture of agent and voice systems, document key decisions and explain trade-offs

to engineers, product and clients.

* Break client requirements into technical designs and delivery milestones, and assign work across

the team.

* Review code and designs, and set team standards for testing, evaluation, monitoring and

release.

* Mentor AI engineers through pairing, design reviews and feedback, and help them grow into

owning features end to end.

* Lead incident response for production issues, run blameless post-mortems and drive the fixes to

completion.

**Required qualifications and skills**

* Strong Python and backend skills: APIs, asyncio, WebSockets, structured error handling and

automated tests.

* Hands-on experience shipping LLM agents beyond a prompt demo: tool calling, state

management, RAG and failure handling in a real workflow.

* Sound judgement on agent design: when a fixed workflow beats an autonomous agent, single

versus multi-agent, and how to keep agents safe with permissions and guardrails.

* Working knowledge of a real-time voice stack: streaming ASR and TTS, VAD, turn-taking and the

trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

* Experience designing evaluations for LLM agents: test sets, trajectory and outcome metrics,

LLM-as-judge and regression tracking — and knowing when a metric is misleading.

* Ability to debug across services using logs, traces and recorded sessions to find where an agent

failed or slowed down.

* Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Git, Docker and CI pipelines.
* Evidence of owning production services from design through operation, including reliability

under real traffic.

* Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing their work and leading technical decisions with

product or client stakeholders.

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with clear examples of

delivered work.

**Preferred experience**

* Agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Temporal or

MCP tool servers.

* Production voice agents on telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) or WebRTC, with frameworks such as

LiveKit Agents or Pipecat.

* Speech providers such as Deepgram, Whisper, Google STT, ElevenLabs, Azure TTS or Cartesia,

and measuring their WER and latency on your own data.

* Indian-language and code-switched speech (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and English).
* Queues, caching and event-driven systems (Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and load-testing tools such

as Locust or k6.

* Access controls, PII redaction and on-premises or restricted-network deployments.
* Other modalities, such as vision or document understanding (images, screenshots, scanned

forms), and combining them with voice or text in one agent.

**Success in the role**

Success means AI agents — voice, chat or back-office — that complete real business tasks reliably, with

evidence that they work, and a team that ships them with confidence. In your first six months, that looks

like:

* Business outcomes: agents measurably resolve tasks without human help, cut handling time

and raise customer satisfaction for client use cases.

* Reliability: workflows recover from timeouts, tool failures and bad input; write actions are

never duplicated; every incident is traced to a cause and fixed.

* Evaluation culture: every release is gated by evals, metrics track what users actually experience,

and production failures flow back into the test sets.

* Performance and cost: latency and per-task model cost stay within agreed budgets as traffic

grows.

* Delivery: client requirements become working integrations on schedule, with clear handover to

product and delivery teams.

* Engineering quality: features are tested, observable, documented and easy for others to

maintain.

* Team growth: architecture decisions are documented, engineers you mentor own features end

to end, and the team ships faster with fewer production issues.

title: AI Platforms Engineer
description:
Overview:

The AI Observability Engineer (Agentic Frameworks & AI Agent Operations Center Developer) builds and operationalizes agentic AI solutions using modern orchestration frameworks and contributes to an AI Agent Operations Center that enables safe, reliable, and observable agent behavior at scale. This role focuses on developing agent workflows (planning, tool execution, memory, and RAG), integrating guardrails and evaluations, and delivering operational capabilities such as run management, telemetry, and incident triage for production agents.

  
Responsibilities:

* **AI Agent Operations Center (70%)**
  + Build “operations center” capabilities for agent runtime management: agent registry, versioning, deployment tracking, and run histories
  + Enable operational workflows such as incident triage, replay/debug runs, trace correlation, and root-cause analysis across agent steps
  + Implement operational dashboards and views for agent health: success rate, latency, tool failure rate, cost per run, and loop detection
  + Instrument agent flows end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (or equivalent), enabling correlation across prompts, tool calls, retrieval, and responses
  + Implement semantic conventions and tagging standards (agent name/version, tool name, model provider, environment, tenant/app)
  + Partner with SRE/observability teams to ensure production-grade monitoring, alerting, and operational readiness
* **Collaboration with Teams (10%)**
  + Collaborate with transformation teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and tailor AI agents to specific domains.
  + Work closely with AI platform teams to build scalable and cross-domain AI agents while ensuring end-to-end observability.
* **Integration & Deployment (10%)**
  + Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for agent services and operations center components, including automated testing and deployment
  + Automate onboarding for new agent use cases (templates, scaffolding, configuration checks)
  + Drive best practices for secure, scalable, and cost-effective agent deployments
* **Continuous Learning (10%)**
  + Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning technologies and integrate these into existing or new AI agents.
  + Conduct thorough testing and validation to ensure the reliability and accuracy of AI agents and solutions.

* Decision-Making Autonomy Moderate – Significant autonomy in the technical aspects of AI model development and implementation, working under the strategic direction provided by the Senior AI Solutions leads.
* Supervision Required Moderate – Operates with general guidance from the Senior AI Solutions leads, with regular updates for alignment and support.
* Complexity of Role High – The role requires managing complex AI/ML projects, working with large datasets, and ensuring successful integration with existing systems while maintaining scalability.
* Cross-Functional Interactions Yes – Regular interaction with Data Science, Engineering, IT, digital products and business stakeholders to ensure effective AI solution Observability.

  
Qualifications:

Key Skills/Experience Required Minimum Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 3–5+ years of software engineering experience; 1+ years building and observe AI/ML or GenAI applications preferred
* Required Expertise:
* + Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks (Crew.ai, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or similar)
  + Proficiency in Python (primary) and familiarity with APIs/microservices patterns
  + Strong experience with RAG patterns (embeddings, vector search, retrieval evaluation, chunking strategies)
  + Experience with cloud environments (Azure/AWS/GCP) and containerized deployments (Kubernetes/AKS/EKS)
  + Familiarity with observability fundamentals (logs/metrics/traces) and production troubleshooting
  + Experience building internal developer platforms or operational consoles (agent registry, run tracking, dashboards)
  + Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and telemetry pipelines
  + Experience with Azure AI Search / vector databases, prompt/version management, and evaluation frameworks
  + Knowledge of Responsible AI practices: data handling, safety guardrails, audit trails, and redaction strategies

FinOps exposure: token/GPU cost optimization and chargeback/showback reporting

Drentiating Competencies Required

* Technical Proficiency: Agent orchestration design (planning, tool execution, memory, RAG), Strong engineering discipline: testing, versioning, CI/CD, automation, Operational mindset: reliability, debuggability, and incident response support
* Problem-Solving: Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions.
* Collaboration Skills: Effective at working within cross-functional teams.
* Agility: Flexibility to adapt to changing requirements and new technologies.
* Communication Skills: Capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Lead Silicon Design Engineer
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE:**

We are looking for an accomplished **Analog and Mixed-Signal Design Engineer** with relevant **years of semiconductor design experience** to develop high-performance, power-efficient analog, mixed-signal, and I/O circuits for advanced SoCs.

This is a highly technical role for an engineer who thrives on solving challenging circuit-design problems across **advanced process nodes, high-speed interfaces, GPIO/I/O subsystems, power management, sensing, and mixed-signal integration**. You will take designs from architecture and transistor-level implementation through verification, physical design, sign-off, and silicon bring-up, working closely with architecture, SoC, package, SI/PI, reliability, verification, and product engineering teams.

**THE PERSON:**

You are a strong circuit designer with deep understanding of **CMOS Analog and Mixed-signal design**, complemented by the ability to see the larger SoC and system context. You are comfortable making design trade-offs across **performance, power, area, reliability, signal integrity, process variation, and time-to-market**.

You combine hands-on transistor-level expertise with technical leadership and can independently drive complex designs, resolve ambiguous technical problems, and collaborate effectively across geographically distributed engineering teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Architect, design, and deliver advanced **analog, mixed-signal, and I/O circuits** for high-performance SoCs.
* Develop and optimize circuits such as **GPIO/I/O interfaces, transmitters and receivers, level shifters, voltage detectors, clocking/support circuits, sensors, bias circuits, analog control circuits, and power-management interfaces**.
* Perform detailed **PVT, Monte Carlo, mismatch, noise, jitter, timing, power, and reliability analyses** to ensure robust operation across manufacturing and operating conditions.
* Analyze I/O interfaces for **signal integrity, power integrity, supply droop, ground bounce, termination, loading, and package/board interactions**.
* Ensure designs meet appropriate **ESD, EOS, electromigration, aging, TDDB, voltage-stress, and device-reliability** requirements.
* Partner closely with **layout engineers** to drive matching, shielding, parasitic management, floorplanning, power routing, and analog layout quality.
* Collaborate with **SoC architecture, RTL/DV, DFT, physical design, package, board, SI/PI, firmware, reliability, and product engineering** teams to enable successful IP integration.
* Develop behavioral models and specifications that enable efficient **mixed-signal and SoC-level verification**.
* Support **post-layout verification, design reviews, tape-out, silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and production qualification**.
* Identify design risks early and drive technically sound solutions through data-driven analysis.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
**Overview**  

Are you a customer-obsessed, AI-curious problem-solver who thrives in an inclusive, collaborative global team? Join Engineering Operations (EngOps), the organization driving operational excellence across the Microsoft Cloud to strengthen quality, reliability, security, and customer trust.

Our mission is to prevent issues before they happen by turning operational signals into action through AI-powered automation, enabling measurable customer impact at cloud scale. Our culture of empowerment, inclusion, and growth mindset defines how we work.

Within EngOps ACES, the Agent Fleet Operations (AFO) team is looking for an AI-first software engineer to join the Cloud Operational Demand Engineering (CØDE) organization and help advance our mission of driving operational demand to zero. We're seeking a hands-on engineer with a DevOps background — CI/CD and release engineering, safe deployment, observability, and always-on production operations — who pairs that discipline with AI engineering skills and a learn-it-all mindset.

You are passionate about applying AI to solve real customer problems and energized by the challenge of eliminating operational toil.

In this role, you will build and ship production AI solutions that reduce operational demand and improve customer outcomes. You will contribute to the technical execution that turns unresolved cases into autonomously resolved, customer-delighting outcomes — and help build the release, observability, and reliability practices that let a fleet of agents run safely in the customer path.

Role summary

As an individual contributor, you will be hands-on building and improving the agentic patterns that reduce operational demand and improve customer satisfaction. This is a DevOps and production-operations engineering role applied to autonomous AI: you own the delivery, quality, and production health of the components you build, not just their design. This role suits an engineer who has built and shipped production-scale AI systems — and ideally the CI/CD, safe-deployment, and reliability practices around them — and who wants to go deep on agentic resolution while collaborating closely across the team.

Team charter

Build, operationalize, and scale AI-native support experiences for Broad Commercial customers by transforming supportability knowledge into reusable, versioned, testable, and measurable assets that power product experiences, support engineers, and autonomous agents. The team reduces support demand, engineering toil, and time-to-resolution through AI-driven resolution capabilities that continuously learn from customer signals, unresolved cases, and operational insights.

AFO operates a fleet of autonomous agents that resolve customer support cases with human oversight. This is a production DevOps discipline, not a set of prototypes: agents run continuously in the customer path and released, observed, and improved with the same rigor as any always-on service. You and your team will build and run this system across several planes of a single AIOps suite:

* Fleet execution and live safety: operating the agents that execute individual cases end to end — evidence acquisition, diagnosis, reasoning, response composition, and safe escalation — alongside the live-safety services that continuously watch sentiment, risk, and unsafe or irreversible actions and can pause autonomy or transfer a case to a human.
* Evaluation and repair: running the evaluation systems that judge per-turn and completed-case quality, and the repair pipelines that turn failures into durable fixes — documentation, diagnostics, prompt/routing/policy changes, reusable skills, or product work items routed to the right engineering team.
* A control and learning plane: owning the lifecycle state machine that moves every change from observed detected diagnosed repair candidate independently evaluated approved shadowed canaried released production-verified, with explicit expand, pause, revise,

  
**Responsibilities**  

* Build agentic resolution capabilities for AFO
* Build and improve agentic patterns that raise autonomous resolution rate, accuracy, and customer satisfaction, contributing to the team's technical execution.
* Deliver engineering for Agentic AI solutions
* Deliver end-to-end features across autonomous AI systems, including orchestration, reasoning, retrieval, action execution, and human escalation workflows. Take capabilities from prototype through production across support surfaces while partnering effectively across dependent engineering teams.
* Contribute to technical direction and engineering standards
* Help shape the technical foundation for agent development by implementing architectures, design patterns, evaluation frameworks, and reusable platform capabilities.
* Apply and help improve standards for prompts, tool interfaces, testing, versioning, code quality, CI/CD, and safe deployment practices (shadow, canary, progressive rollout, automated rollback) so agent behavior remains reliable, observable, and scalable.
* Build evals that improve customer confidence that our agents are trustworthy in understanding customer sentiment and intent and in validating agentic actions.
* Contribute to production health and reliability
* Help run the service with a DevOps/SRE operating model. Support availability, latency, cost per resolution, SLOs and error budgets, regression detection, incident response, and the on-call rotation for a fleet of agents acting autonomously in the customer path. Build the observability needed to explain why an agent did what it did, and drive durable fixes rather than repeated mitigations.
* Build and maintain evaluation systems
* Contribute to the evaluation framework that determines whether agents are safe and effective in production. Build and maintain golden datasets, rubrics, judge agents, frozen anchors, and offline/online evaluation pipelines. Use evaluation signals to gate releases and continuously improve quality through production feedback loops.
* Contribute to measurable business impact
* Help move key business outcomes, including support demand reduction, autonomous resolution rate, resolution quality, time-to-resolution, engineer productivity, and customer satisfaction. Ensure the capabilities you build are measurable and directed toward the highest-impact opportunities.
* Turn Customer Signals into Engineering Insight
* Build mechanisms that convert unresolved cases, customer feedback, and dissatisfaction signals into actionable engineering insights. Help ensure recurring failure patterns improve future agent capabilities and route product fixes back to the appropriate engineering teams.
* Grow your craft and share learnings
* Deepen your agentic AI and DevOps craft, and extend the team's impact by sharing proven patterns, tools, and operational learnings with your peers.

 **Qualifications**  

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND +8 years technical engineering experience in software engineering, applied AI/ML, or distributed systems, OR equivalent experience.

* 8+ years of IT experience and 3+ years of experience using Agentic AI
* Demonstrated hands-on experience building and shipping AI or machine learning systems in production.
* Demonstrated DevOps or SRE background: hands-on experience with CI/CD and release engineering, safe-deployment practices (e.g., blue/green, canary, progressive rollout, automated rollback), observability and monitoring, and participation in production incident response and on-call for always-on services.

Preferred qualifications

* Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, or a related field.
* Experience building and shipping multi-agent orchestration systems or agentic AI services in production.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks: rubrics, golden datasets, judge agents, offline and online evaluation.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with agent security patterns: prompt injection defense, tool access controls, data boundary enforcement.
* DevOps/SRE toolchain depth: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, and progressive-delivery tooling (shadow, canary, feature/rollout gating, automated rollback).
* Observability engineering: building tracing, metrics, and logging for distributed or agentic systems and using them to drive durable fixes rather than repeated mitigations.
* Reliability practice: working with SLIs/SLOs and error budgets and taking part in the operational rhythm (live-site reviews, post-incident reviews, repair-item and corrective-action tracking) that keeps a fleet healthy.
* Experience contributing to cross-org or co-development engineering delivery with partner teams.
* Business acumen, with the ability to connect engineering work to measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Background in customer support engineering, supportability, or customer experience platforms.
* Experience operating always-on production services, including on-call participation and incident response.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Linux Engineer (24*7 Operations)
description:
