We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Linux Engineer to support our 24/7 Operations environment on a rotational shift basis. You will be responsible for monitoring and supporting Linux-based production systems, responding to alerts and incidents, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, and ensuring services remain stable and available.

You will work closely with Shift Leads, senior engineers, application teams, network teams, database teams, and other support functions to resolve incidents within SLA and maintain reliable production services.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Linux Operations**

* Provide L1/L2 support for Linux servers including **RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu and Amazon Linux**.
* Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk space, disk I/O, system load, network connectivity and service-related issues.
* Manage Linux users, groups, permissions, file systems and access.
* Monitor and manage services using **systemd/systemctl**.
* Perform filesystem and **LVM** administration, including monitoring capacity and supporting filesystem extensions.
* Troubleshoot networking issues involving DNS, TCP/IP, routing, ports, firewalls and SSH connectivity.
* Analyse system and application logs to identify errors and service failures.
* Manage cron jobs and scheduled operational tasks.
* Support package updates, patching, server reboots and routine maintenance activities.
* Perform approved production changes following change management procedures.

**Monitoring and Incident Management**

* Monitor infrastructure and application alerts using tools such as **CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana or Datadog**.
* Respond to alerts and incidents promptly and perform initial troubleshooting.
* Identify recurring or false-positive alerts and raise recommendations for alert tuning.
* Create, update and manage incidents through the appropriate ticketing system.
* Work on incidents based on priority, business impact and SLA.
* Escalate complex or critical issues to Shift Leads, L3 support, engineering or relevant resolver teams.
* Participate in major incident and bridge calls when required.
* Provide clear technical findings and regular updates during ongoing incidents.
* Ensure incidents are properly documented before resolution and closure.

**Operational Checks**

* Perform scheduled health checks for Linux servers and production services.
* Validate CPU, memory, filesystem, network and critical process/service status.
* Monitor backups, scheduled jobs and other operational activities where applicable.
* Perform pre-change and post-change validation.
* Carry out application and infrastructure connectivity checks following approved runbooks.
* Ensure outstanding alerts, incidents and operational risks are clearly communicated during shift handovers.

**Scripting and Automation**

* Write and maintain **Bash scripts** for routine administration and monitoring activities.
* Use **Python** where appropriate for operational automation.
* Identify repetitive manual tasks that can be automated.
* Support improvements to monitoring and operational scripts.
* Follow scripting, testing and change control standards before implementing automation in production.

**Documentation and Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs and troubleshooting guides.
* Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions for recurring incidents.
* Update knowledge base articles when new issues or solutions are identified.
* Ensure accurate documentation of incidents, changes and operational activities.
* Share technical knowledge with other Operations team members.

**Shift Operations**

* Work as part of a **24/7 rotational shift team**, including nights, weekends and public holidays.
* Take ownership of assigned incidents, service requests, alerts and operational tasks.
* Follow structured shift handover procedures.
* Clearly communicate open issues, pending actions, planned changes and risks to the incoming shift.
* Escalate critical issues to the Shift Lead without unnecessary delay.
* Support priority incidents until resolution or successful handover.

**Process and Compliance**

* Follow **ITIL practices** for incident, problem and change management.
* Follow approved change procedures for production activities.
* Comply with security, access management and infrastructure standards.
* Ensure privileged access and administrative activities follow organisational policies.
* Participate in root cause analysis and post-incident reviews where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve system reliability and reduce operational workload.

### **Required Skills and Experience:**

* 4+ years of experience in **Linux administration, infrastructure operations, NOC or production support**.
* Experience supporting systems in a **24/7 production environment**.

title: Applied AI Engineer II
description:
**Overview**  

ACES CØDE is a Microsoft engineering organization focused on reducing operational demand across the Microsoft Cloud, including but not limited to the avoidable support cases, repeated troubleshooting, and manual interventions that arise when cloud products, platforms, or processes do not work as intended. Our mission is to engineer this demand out of the Microsoft Cloud by turning customer and operational signals into lasting product improvements, intelligent diagnostics, autonomous resolution systems, and AI-powered capabilities. As cloud services grow in scale and complexity, we are moving beyond simply reacting to problems after they occur. We work to understand why operational demand exists, prevent it at the source where possible, resolve it autonomously when it does occur, and continuously learn from those signals to make our products and support experiences more reliable. We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes.

Within this mission, the ACES CØDE engineering team is building domain-specific agents and services that are transforming Azure customer support from reactive, human-dependent workflows toward AI-first systems capable of resolving customer issues at Azure scale. We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to help build the next generation of production agentic AI services that resolve customer issues faster, reduce avoidable support demand, and improve the reliability and scalability of AI-first support experiences. You will take product specifications and turn them into production-ready, scalable AI services — working with LLM orchestration, multi-agent coordination, and RAG-based systems. You will ship production services that directly impact Azure customers.

Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help our team provide our customers with the world-class cloud services they need to succeed.

title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
* Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
* Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
* Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
* Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
* Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
* Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

  
A day in the life  
You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. title: Staff Detection & Response Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
Fanatics is seeking an experienced Staff Security Engineer to join our Detection and Response team, bringing hands-on expertise in incident response, detection engineering, and SOAR development to help scale our security operations. The ideal candidate combines a defensive practitioner's mindset with deep knowledge of adversarial TTPs, driving continuous improvement across detections, automated workflows, and cross-team security partnerships. The Staff Security Engineer, Detection & Response delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

**HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT**  
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Provide technical input and direction on detection and response projects, including tasking, reviewing peer engineers' work, and mentoring team members to elevate the team's overall capability.  
Partner with leadership and peers to gather requirements, priorities, and enhancement requests, translating them into data, tooling, and integration requirements that align with organizational goals.  
Collaborate closely with engineering teams across the organization to continuously define use cases and requirements for enabling technologies including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, Intrusion Detection Systems, Secure Web Gateway, DNS security, System Hardening, Identity Management, and PKI.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

Respond to security incidents and conduct thorough investigations, clearly articulating potential risks and remediation strategies to stakeholders at all levels to protect the platform and the fan experience.  
Apply a usable security philosophy — ensuring that security controls and processes protect Fanatics' fans and data without disrupting the pace of innovation that drives the business.  
Participate in an on-call rotation, monitoring the real-world performance of detections and automated workflows to ensure continuous coverage and rapid response.  
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations with exceptional clarity to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across internal and external audiences.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

Design, develop, test, and continuously optimize detection rules and SOAR workflows using engineering best practices, enabling faster anomaly identification and more consistent incident response at scale.  
Conduct proactive threat hunts and threat modeling exercises, drawing on attacker TTP insights to identify potential indicators of compromise and translate findings into actionable security controls.  
Evaluate and operationalize AI-assisted security tooling to expand detection coverage, increase response speed, and scale the team's capabilities as Fanatics continues to grow.  
Leverage detection-as-code methodologies and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) to manage and evolve the detection library in a disciplined, repeatable, and auditable manner.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

Own the full lifecycle of detections, automated response workflows, playbooks, integrations, and scripts — including authoring and maintaining thorough documentation for each.  
Contribute to process and technology improvement after each incident, ensuring the team learns, adapts, and raises its baseline after every event.  
Analyze endpoint, network, and application logs for anomalous activity at enterprise scale, applying strong data analysis and correlation skills to surface meaningful signals from noise.  
Operate effectively as an independent contributor within a highly distributed, multi-region SOC environment, demonstrating strong organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced, rapidly changing setting.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes  
Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance  
Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working  
Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING**

**Required Qualifications:**

8+ years of experience in technical information security roles with a focus on security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response, including hands-on incident response experience managing complex investigations with multiple stakeholders.  
Advanced experience with enterprise SIEM platforms, including the design and development of detections, reports, and dashboards, combined with strong SOAR development skills and proven experience automating security response workflows at enterprise scale.  
Deep working knowledge of adversary TTPs and demonstrated experience applying MITRE ATT&CK principles to detect and respond to security incidents, including use of penetration testing and ATT&CK framework tools to simulate adversarial behaviors.  
Strong conceptual knowledge of OS internals and malware functionality — including persistence mechanisms — sufficient to author endpoint detections directly from raw telemetry.  
Proficiency with scripting, REST APIs, query languages, and CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) for automation, alert enrichment, detection development, and detection-as-code workflows.  
Experience evaluating and operating AI-assisted security tooling, and familiarity with working in hybrid environments that include both on-premise and cloud-based systems.  
Exceptional communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to objectively evaluate security risk and operate with a high degree of autonomy within a distributed, multi-region team.

*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*  
  
***ABOUT US***  
*Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.*

***ABOUT THE TEAM***  
*Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site,* *www.fanatics.com**.*  
  
*Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).*  
  
*At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:*  

* *Build Championship Teams*
* *Obsessed with Fans*
* *Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit*
* *Determined and Relentless Mindset*

title: Senior Verification Engineer, PCIE
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an elite Senior Verification Engineer to verify the design and implementation of the next generation of PCI Express controllers for the world’s leading GPUs and SOCs. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have crafted a team of outstanding people stretching around the globe, whose mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. At NVIDIA, our employees are passionate about parallel and visual computing. We're united in our quest to transform the way graphics are used to solve some of the most complex problems in computer science.

The GPU started out as an engine for simulating human imagination, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI computing company.”

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Be responsible for verification of the ASIC design, architecture, golden models and micro-architecture of PCIE controllers at IP/sub-system levels using state-of-the-art verification methodologies such as UVM.
* Build reusable bus functional models, monitors, checkers and scoreboards following coverage driven verification methodology.
* Expected to understand the design specification and implementation, define the verification scope, develop test plans, tests, and the verification infrastructure and verify the correctness of the design.
* You will be collaborating with architects, designers, and pre and post silicon verification teams to accomplish your tasks.

**What we need to see:**

* B.Tech./ M.Tech or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of relevant experience
* Experience in verification at Unit/Sub-system/SOC level and expertise in Verilog and SystemVerilog
* Expertise in comprehensive verification of IP or interconnect protocols (e.g. PCI Express, USB, SATA)
* Experience in developing and working in functional coverage based constrained random verification environments
* Background in DV methodologies like UVM/VMM and exposure to industry standard verification tools for simulation and debug

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Excellent knowledge of PCIE protocol - Gen3 and above
* Good understanding of the system level architecture of PCIE/CXL-based designs
* Perl, Python or similar scripting and SW programming language experience
* Good debugging and analytical skills
* Good interpersonal skills & dream to work as a great teammate

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. title: Software Development Manager, GREF Tech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.  
  
We are seeking a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead the development of new services that power the end-to-end travel and expense experience for Amazonians worldwide. You will build and ship solutions across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules — integrating AI capabilities such as intelligent policy guidance, automated expense categorization, and GenAI-driven workflows into production systems that must work reliably across 64 countries, multiple currencies, and diverse regulatory environments.  
  
You will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Front-End Engineers (FEEs), and Applied Scientists to translate the platform vision into scalable, high-quality services that simplify how employees travel, host events, and manage expenses.  
  
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building and leading teams of software engineers, front-end engineers, and technical program managers, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-level systems at scale. They will be a strategic thinker who hires and develops exceptional talent, sets clear goals tied to organizational impact, and independently manages both day-to-day execution and long-term roadmap priorities — fostering a high-performance, team-oriented culture.

title: Senior Linux Drivers Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**About Axiado**

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet.

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description**

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Engineer - Linux Kernel and Device Driver to provide technical leadership for the architecture, development, and optimization of our low-level software stack. This role requires strong expertise in debugging complex system-level issues and performing root-cause analysis across hardware and software layers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build robust and scalable solutions for next-generation embedded systems.

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, development, and maintenance of Linux kernel modules and subsystems, with a strong focus on device drivers for a variety of hardware interfaces (e.g., Ethernet, PCIe, USB, I2C, SPI, SGPIO, eSPI, Display).
* Own the kernel-level aspects of system integration and board bring-up. Collaborate with hardware and other software teams to define interfaces, debug bring-up issues, and validate functionality.
* Employ expert-level debugging skills to diagnose and resolve complex kernel-level issues, including kernel panics, race conditions, and tricky hardware-software interactions.
* Partner with hardware and system-level software teams to define requirements, co-design interfaces, and ensure seamless hardware-software integration.
* Participate in the broader Linux kernel community, contributing patches, and staying current with evolving kernel development.
* Use advanced tools (e.g., ftrace, perf, kdump) to profile the kernel and drivers, and implement improvements for stability and performance.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in Linux kernel development, with a specialization in device drivers. Deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals, including memory management, process scheduling, and concurrency.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and assembly programming for embedded systems.
* Strong experience with Linux kernel, device drivers, and system-level software.
* Proficiency in debugging tools such as GDB, JTAG, Lauterbach, serial consoles, and oscilloscopes.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis for hardware/software interaction issues.
* Hands-on experience with embedded Linux systems, Drivers, Board Support Packages (BSPs), and bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot).
* Familiarity with one or more of the hardware communication protocols like I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, USB, SGPIO, eMMC, eSPI, Display, and Ethernet.
* Experience with Yocto Project, Buildroot, and cross-compilation toolchains.
* Experience with Software open-source methodologies for Linux Kernel and related projects is a plus.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse technical teams.

 **Additional Information**

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

* Experience defining die-to-die and chiplet based RDL/bump architecture.
* Direct collaboration with OSATs, foundries, and substrate suppliers for co-development and ramp.
* Strong cross-functional leadership across design, product, test, operations, reliability, and customer teams.

title: GTM Engineer(Go-To-Market Strategist)
description:
### **About the Role**

Techdome is looking for a GTM Engineer to lead how we bring our products and services to market. In simple terms, you will decide **who we sell to, what we say to them, and where we reach them**, and then run the paid advertising campaigns that turn that plan into real leads and revenue.

Your main focus will be **Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram)**, along with other platforms like Google and LinkedIn. You will manage ad budgets, track results, and continuously improve performance. This role suits someone who enjoys taking ownership, working with numbers, and building new growth systems from the ground up.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Go-to-Market Strategy**

* Define our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and identify the right market segments to target.
* Create clear positioning and messaging for our products and services.
* Choose the right mix of marketing channels for each offering.
* Plan and manage product and service launches, from strategy to live campaigns.
* Work closely with the design, product, and sales teams to keep messaging consistent.

**Paid Advertising**

* Manage Meta Ads end to end, including audience targeting, creative testing, bidding, and scaling.
* Plan, launch, and grow campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, and new channels.
* Manage advertising budgets and ensure money is spent efficiently.
* Build and improve the full marketing funnel, from first contact to closed deal.

**Tracking and Analytics**

* Set up and maintain tracking tools such as pixels, Conversions API, event tagging, and UTM links.
* Monitor key metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS using GA4 and other tools.
* Run A/B tests on ads, landing pages, messaging, and audiences, and record what works.
* Keep CRM data accurate and share clear performance reports with the team.

**AI and Efficiency**

* Use AI tools to speed up ad copywriting, creative production, campaign optimization, and reporting.

### **Requirements**

* 1.5+ years of experience in digital or performance marketing.
* Strong, hands-on experience running Meta Ads.
* Experience growing campaigns across more than one ad platform.
* Experience creating or executing go-to-market plans, including positioning, segmentation, and launches.
* Comfort managing a budget and being responsible for results.
* Good understanding of marketing funnels, audience segmentation, and retargeting.
* Working knowledge of GA4 and CRM or marketing automation tools.
* Familiarity with AI marketing tools, such as copywriting assistants and creative generators.
* Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills.
* Clear communication and strong analytical thinking.
* A proactive attitude and interest in building new things.

### **Good to Have**

* Basic knowledge of SQL.
* Experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar analytics tools.
* Background in product positioning, pricing, or marketing automation.
* Interest in AI-based marketing analytics or predictive modeling.

### **What We Offer**

* **Ownership:** Lead GTM strategy and campaigns that directly impact company revenue.
* **Autonomy:** Freedom to make decisions from day one.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with product, sales, and design teams.
* **Open culture:** A flat team that encourages new ideas and fast learning.
* **Growth:** A clear path toward senior GTM or marketing leadership roles.

description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the Yocto-based build infrastructure and board support software that enable AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGAs. You will own the layers, distributions, and toolchains that turn new AMD silicon into a buildable, supportable software platform for Linux, OpenBMC, and real-time workloads.

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, kernel and firmware teams, and the Yocto and OpenEmbedded communities, you will take new silicon from first power-on to a supportable, upstreamable platform, and build the images, SDKs, and reference designs customers develop against.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about embedded Linux and build systems, and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in Yocto and board support package development, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through silicon bring-up and into production.

You are comfortable across the full stack, from a device tree node to a released SDK, and collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Yocto Build Infrastructure:** Design and maintain the Yocto and OpenEmbedded layers that enable new AMD silicon — SoC family definitions, machine configurations, tunes, and layer architecture across BSP and distro layers.
* **Kernel, Bootloader and Boot Image Integration:** Integrate recipes for the Linux kernel, U-Boot, TF-A, and platform firmware, and build the boot artifact pipeline — device tree packaging, flash layout, signing, secure boot, and golden-image recovery.
* **Multi-Domain Builds and SDKs:** Define multiconfig builds that produce Linux, RTOS, firmware, and programmable logic artifacts together, and deliver the SDKs and toolchains teams develop against.
* **Adaptive SoC and Programmable Logic:** Integrate programmable logic into the software stack, including bitstream packaging, device tree overlays, and enabling PL interfaces from Linux.
* **Silicon and Board Bring-Up:** Participate in new silicon and board bring-up from first power-on, holding the integrated image and driving issues to root cause with hardware and firmware teams.
* **CI, Release and Technical Leadership:** Maintain QEMU-based virtual platforms and continuous integration, deliver release artifacts and software bills of materials, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Deep hands-on experience with the **Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, and BitBake** — authoring recipes, bbappends, and classes, building BSP and distro layers, SDK generation, and diagnosing complex build failures.
* Strong **embedded Linux** and board support package background: the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint, device trees, kernel configuration and fragments, driver enablement, and bootloaders and early firmware such as **U-Boot and TF-A**.
* Familiarity with **BMC products and the platform management domain**, and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, eSPI, and PECI.
* Strong programming skills in **C and C++**, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting for build and automation work.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning build systems, operating systems, drivers, bootloaders, and firmware, and familiarity with **Git and CI/CD** workflows.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with **AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies**, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™ and hardware/software co-design.
* **Zephyr or another embedded RTOS**, and **RISC-V** or other non-x86 architectures, including board enablement and toolchain integration.
* Inter-processor communication frameworks such as **OpenAMP** in heterogeneous multi-core systems.
* Experience with **OpenBMC** or a comparable BMC software stack and its integration into a Yocto distribution.
* **QEMU** or comparable virtual platforms for pre-silicon development and continuous integration.
* Experience developing **reference designs or proof-of-concept solutions**, and release engineering at scale including SBOM and CVE triage.
* Contributions to the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, or Linux open-source projects, with strong analytical and communication skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**About Meeru AI**

Meeru AI is building an AI-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP&A leaders.

We deploy on customer terms — \*\*SaaS multi-tenant, SaaS single-tenant, and on-premises\*\* — across \*\*AWS, Azure, and GCP\*\*. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.

**The Role**

We are looking for a \*\*Staff AI Engineer\*\* to own the AI and intelligence layer — and the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data.

You own the machine-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural-language output, and the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You build per-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect, and you set a high bar for evaluation and grounding across the layer.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You set technical direction for the AI layer, partner closely with the evaluation engineer to make quality measurable, and turn user feedback into durable improvements.

**What makes this role different**

* Grounding is a hard requirement no fabricated or unsupported output, ever. Faithfulness is a gate, not a tuning goal
* Clear separation of concerns ML surfaces and prioritizes; generated text only states what is supported by verified data or confirmed by a human
* Per-customer intelligence models that learn each business's behavior, with strict anti-leakage discipline
* Deploys in customer clouds including managed LLMs in-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment

  
**Requirements**  

* **Staff-level applied ML/AI experience in production.** You have shipped and owned real ML and AI systems used by customers, and you have set technical direction for others, not only built prototypes.
* **Strong classical machine learning.** Hands-on depth in time-series modeling, anomaly and outlier detection, and gradient-boosted models such as LightGBM or XGBoost, using Python, scikit-learn and pandas or Polars.
* **Modern LLM and agent patterns.** You have built retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and structured (schema-validated) output, and orchestrated them with LangGraph or a similar framework.
* **Rigor on evaluation, grounding and hallucination control.** You know how to measure whether an LLM's output is faithful to its source data, and you have built guardrails that stop unsupported statements from reaching users.
* **Discipline around data leakage and honest evaluation.** You design features, splits and validation so models are never trained or scored on information they would not have in real use.
* **Clear thinking about what ML can and cannot claim.** You can explain to non-ML colleagues where a model's output is evidence and where it is only a signal, and why that line matters when results sit next to reported financials.
* **Real software engineering.** You write tested, production-grade Python services, are comfortable with SQL against warehouses like Snowflake or PostgreSQL, and have shipped containerized software.
* **Technical leadership.** You mentor engineers and work closely with backend, data, product and evaluation colleagues to turn feedback into lasting improvements.

Nice-to-haves

* **Finance or accounting domain experience.** Familiarity with ERP, billing or FP&A data and the audit expectations around it.
* **Feature-attribution literacy.** Experience with tools like SHAP, and a clear view of where attribution explanations break down.
* **Human-in-the-loop systems.** You have designed review, confirmation or correction workflows and fed them back into models.
* **Managed LLMs inside customer clouds.** Experience running AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI inside a customer's VPC so their data never leaves their environment.
* **Sparse and zero-inflated data.** Experience modeling rare events or data that is mostly zeros.
* **Multi-deployment enterprise software.** Exposure to products shipped as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant SaaS and on-premises across AWS, Azure and GCP.

Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. **Job Details**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**Associate Success Guide(Proactive TMP) - JD**
===============================================

  
  

For the best candidate experience, please consider applying to — or referring the same person to — a maximum of 3 roles within a 12-month period.
  
  
Internals
  
For interview tips and other internal mobility resources, check out our Internal Career Guide on the Hiring & Onboarding tile in Okta.
  
  
Referrals

* If you do not see the Refer button, this opening is NOT posted externally and therefore is NOT open to external applications or referrals at this time.
  

  

Job Category

Customer Success

  
  

Job Details

  
  

About Salesforce

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

  
  

The role of the Associate Success Guide will be to help grow customers’ value and improve adoption. The Associate Success Guide will engage with customers across all account segments, delivering 1:1 success guidance to Salesforce customers. They will partner with Success Managers and Sales.

  
  

The ideal candidate is organized, agile, and passionate about Customer Success. They have excellent presentation and communication skills in both a 1 on 1 and group setting. Using their product knowledge, they deliver value to customers and internal teams.

  
  
  

### **Your Impact**

* Usage & Adoption: Offer best practices and technical guidance to boost adoption, support migrations/EOL communications, and drive business outcomes.
* Customer Engagements: Deliver 1:1 coaching and handle Success Requests across segments.
* Operational Excellence: Work in line with Global Guide SOPs.
* Collaboration: Generate positive feedback and contribute to team growth.
Learning : Stay updated through enablement, ACT training, and Trailhead.  

  

Responsibilities

* Deliver 1:1 expert coaching sessions and respond to Success Requests with clear, actionable guidance.
* Share best practices, product education, and technical insights across multiple clouds and product areas.
* Drive proactive engagements for all customers to accelerate feature and cloud adoption.
* Lead consultative customer interactions and support cross-functional Success teams.
* Contribute to team development by mentoring peers and participating in internal and external enablement initiatives, including content creation.
* Engage in ongoing product upskilling efforts and provide feedback to enhance internal programs.
* Ensure timely completion of all company-mandated and role-specific ACT training courses.
  

  

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.) - Engineer Degree Preferred
* Comfortable with AMER Hours (EST Timezone 5:30 PM IST or PST 8:30 PM IST)
* 6 - 30 months of relevant work experience or hands-on experience with any Salesforce product.
* Strong consultative mindset with a customer-first approach.
* Ability to communicate, present, and influence effectively across diverse audiences.
* Proven aptitude for quickly learning new technologies and thriving in a fast-paced environment.
* Skilled at prioritizing, multitasking, and delivering under pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  
Preferred Qualifications & Skills

* Proven ability to manage time and prioritize activities while performing effectively under pressure
* Support Success and Sales Teams to ensure customers get maximum value from the platform.
* Proven success leading customer-facing presentations and engagements
* Able to handle objections, prioritise customer issues, and collaborate with manager and colleagues to effectively drive resolution

  
Soft Skills

* Composure: Excellent customer-facing communication and interpersonal skills, capable of supporting complex engagements.
* Expertise: Familiar with industry best practices and experienced in implementing Salesforce products.
* Learner: Enthusiastic about continuous learning and understanding new technologies and complex concepts.
* Passion: Dedicated to Customer Success and an attentive listener.
* Culture: Promotes an inclusive culture and is a collaborative team player.
* Trust: Able to build customer trust and consistently uphold company values.

title: Senior Engineer, Virtualization
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

**AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team.** Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.

### **Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities  

Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues  
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure

* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention

Assess customer environments for performance, capacity, configuration, design, resilience, security, and supportability issues; propose and implement resolutions  

* Provide architectural oversight and validate that proposed changes, designs, and remediation plans align with vendor-supported practices, client standards, capacity, resiliency, security, and service scope

* Work across networking, storage, operating-system, security, monitoring, automation, and application teams to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues

Work with vendors and hardware partners to resolve virtualization and compute issues, coordinate escalations, and implement supported resolutions  

* Own or contribute to problem-management records, corrective actions, preventive actions, post-incident reviews, and technical root-cause analyses for recurring or systemic issues

Lead or support platform lifecycle activities, including upgrade readiness, compatibility validation, capacity planning, end-of-support and end-of-life assessments, patch planning, firmware coordination, and VCF lifecycle management  

Maintain accurate client architecture, access, configuration, monitoring, hardware, firmware, inventory, and maintenance documentation. Reconcile documentation against authoritative platform, CMDB, monitoring, and inventory sources  
* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices

Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency  

Support annual architecture, capacity, lifecycle, and standard-operating-procedure reviews, and provide technical inputs for quarterly business reviews or other strategic client reviews  
Own the technical execution of assigned client onboarding and offboarding activities, including access validation, monitoring coverage, vendor access, initial documentation, known-issue identification, and EoS/EoL review  
* Provide clear technical context, risk, impact, dependencies, recommended actions, and next steps to Client Success Managers and customer technical contacts. Business-impacting or scope-related customer communications should be coordinated through the appropriate Client Success Manager

* Participate in 24x7 operations and the on-call rotation, including major incidents and planned maintenance activities as scheduled

Complete training and certification as assigned to further skills and knowledge  

* Mentor L2 engineers, improve escalation quality, review technical work when assigned, and contribute to standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, training, and continuous-improvement initiatives

### **Qualifications/ Technology Experience**

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Unique education, specialized experience, skills, knowledge, training, or certification may be substituted)  

* 10+ yrs of experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise infrastructure operations
* + Experience with VMware vSphere/VVF required
  + Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) required
  + Experience with Nutanix AHV required
  + Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred
  Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, including virtual-machine lifecycle management, networking, storage integration, and operational troubleshooting
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployment, configuration, lifecycle management, and operational support
* + Proficiency in VCF lifecycle management, including automated deployment, patching, and upgrades using SDDC Manager
  + Experience with VCF workload domains, including VI workload domains and NSX-T network virtualization
  + Knowledge of VCF validated designs and reference architectures for hybrid-cloud implementations
  + Experience with VCF integration with public-cloud services (VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine) preferred
  + Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
  Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security
10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems  
10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)  
5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred  
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required
Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred  
* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred
Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required  
Managed Services or consulting experience required  
VMware Certified Professional certification required; VMware Certified Advanced Professional certification preferred  
* ITILv4 certification preferred

### **Qualifications: Soft Skills**

Advanced technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities  

* Approach projects, changes, and problems with a “security first” mindset

Superior customer service and training skills  

* Possess a strong sense of urgency and ability to set priorities during normal operations and high-impact events

Ability to work without direct supervision and make sound technical decisions  

Team-oriented collaborator willing to share knowledge and experience  
Ability to communicate technical risk, business impact, dependencies, decisions, and recommended actions clearly to engineers, managers, CSMs, vendors, and customer technical stakeholders  
Ability to remain accountable for coordination and follow-through until the next owner formally accepts an escalation  
* Ability to balance customer requests with platform capacity, resiliency, security, contractual scope, change control, and operational risk

Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills and ability to build and maintain collaborative and positive working relationships at all levels  

Ability to effectively interact with all levels of business via phone, written communication, and in person  
Skilled in achieving results in a customer centric environment  
* Self-motivated, able to work in a fast-paced 24x7 managed-services environment

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**India Employment Benefits include:**

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents

**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy

**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work-life balance

**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling

**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well-being

**Retirement and statutory benefits** in line with India regulations

**Inclusive and people-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – AI CoE
description:
**Senior Engineering Manager** **– AI** **CoE**

**About Redwood**

Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments.

Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio.

**Role Mission**

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead the engineering team responsible for delivering Redwood's shared AI platform and agentic capabilities.

You will translate the AI strategy into an executable engineering roadmap, build a high-performing team, and ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, observable, and commercially valuable AI systems. The role requires sufficient technical depth to guide architecture and challenge engineering decisions while remaining accountable for people's leadership, execution, team health, and delivery outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead one or more engineering teams responsible for AI platform services, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and product integrations.
* Translate business and product priorities into a clear engineering roadmap, delivery plan, and team-level objectives.
* Recruit, onboard, manage, and retain engineers with the skills required to build production-grade AI and agentic systems.
* Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, decision-making responsibilities, and development plans across the team.
* Drive predictable execution through effective planning, dependency management, risk identification, and operational readiness.
* Partner with senior individual contributors to guide architecture and technical direction without becoming a bottleneck for engineering decisions.
* Ensure consistent engineering practices across AI evaluation, observability, model governance, security, reliability, performance, and cost management.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, Legal, and product engineering teams to deliver enterprise-ready AI capabilities.
* Balance shared platform investments with customer-facing requirements and immediate product priorities.
* Monitor delivery, quality, platform adoption, incidents, operational performance, and engineering effectiveness.
* Establish an engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer outcomes.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, and career development planning.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements to senior stakeholders.
* Maintain sufficient technical involvement to understand architectural risks, challenge decisions, and support critical engineering outcomes.
  

**Scope and Expected Impact**

  

* Own engineering outcomes for a critical AI platform domain or multiple related engineering teams.
* Convert broad strategic priorities into measurable plans, milestones, and delivery commitments.
* Make organizational, staffing, prioritization, and delivery decisions with medium- to long-term impact.
* Create alignment across senior engineers, Product, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders.
* Improve delivery predictability, platform adoption, engineering quality, and operational reliability.
* Scale the organization through clear ownership, repeatable engineering practices, and strong technical leadership.
* Ensure the team can deliver effectively without depending excessively on any single individual.

  

**Must Have Qualifications**

  

* 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in an engineering people-management or team-leadership role.
* Experience leading one or more engineering teams responsible for complex software products or platform services.
* Demonstrated experience hiring, managing performance, coaching engineers, and supporting career development.
* Track record of delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud, distributed systems, platform, ML, or AI products into production.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI, agentic architectures, LLM-based applications, orchestration, and production deployment considerations.

* Understanding agent workflows involving tool use, retrieval, enterprise data, APIs, memory, guardrails, and human oversight.

* Experience managing technical roadmaps, delivery risks, dependencies, incidents, quality, and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud-native systems, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and observability.
* Ability to guide technical decisions and architecture discussions while empowering senior engineers to own implementation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical and business trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to operate with high autonomy and manage ambiguity in a product or high-scale technology environment.

  

**Strong Plus**

  

* Experience establishing or scaling an AI platform, agentic engineering team, Center of Excellence, or developer platform function.
* Hands-on exposure to LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with AI evaluation platforms, model gateways, vector databases, prompt lifecycle management, or AI observability tools.
* Understanding of responsible AI, model governance, privacy, compliance, and enterprise security requirements.
* Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, automation, or integration platforms.
* Experience balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization of existing enterprise products.
* Experience working in regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability environments.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Builds a healthy, appropriately staffed engineering team with clear responsibilities and strong technical ownership.
* Delivers AI platform and agentic capabilities predictably while maintaining security, reliability, quality, and cost discipline.
* Creates measurable adoption of shared AI capabilities across Redwood's product engineering teams.
* Establishes clear engineering standards for AI evaluation, observability, governance, and production readiness.
* Improves team effectiveness, delivery predictability, and operational performance.
* Develops capable engineers and reduces organizational dependency on individual contributors.
* Provides senior stakeholders with a clear, evidence-based view of progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements.

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

  

**THE LEGAL BIT**  
Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy or any other consideration made unlawful by regional or local laws. We also prohibit discrimination based on a perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is unlawful and will have a zero tolerance policy applied to it.

  

Redwood will comply with all local data protection laws, including GDPR when it comes to the handling and processing of personal data. Should you wish for us to remove your personal data from our recruitment database, please email us directly at Privacy@Redwood.com

title: Software Engineering Lead - Springboot, Python, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo DB
description:

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Leverage AWS and Google Cloud services to deliver secure, resilient, and cloud-native applications

* Experience in healthcare domain and understanding of healthcare data and workflows
* Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience in training team members
* Hand-on experience with AI productivity tools such Github Copilot

We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Engineering Analyst, Payments Trust and Safety
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience in the Payments industry, working on risk or fraud management.
* Experience in querying and analyzing large sets of data.
* Strong project and program management skills and experience.
* Working knowledge in one or more of the following areas: statistical analysis and machine learning libraries (e.g., R, Scikit-learn,TensorFlow), programming languages (e.g., Python, C/C++), Large Language Models (LLMs) or Generative AI.
* Demonstrated ability to identify workflow pain points, optimize, automate and scale processes.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

**About the job**
-----------------

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Promote user trust and safety by managing and mitigating payment fraud and abuse for Google products and services.
* Investigate fraud and abuse incidents, identify patterns and trends in order to generate holistic risk management solutions. Perform end-to-end assessment of the riskiness and vulnerability of products and features, design, and implement fraud and abuse mitigation strategies.
* Perform statistical analysis using payments and risk data warehouse. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to create and enhance tools, develop signals, improve system functionality, accuracy and efficiency.
* Engage and collaborate with cross-functional teams globally. Work closely with engineers, product managers, and various internal and external stakeholders to launch risk mitigation solutions.
* Participate in the on call rotation schedule to manage high priority escalations that may occur outside of standard non work hours including weekends/holidays.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Senior IT Supervisor - Data
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Data Platform & Services organization delivers enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and cloud capabilities that enable scalable, secure, and trusted data solutions across the business. The team is responsible for modernizing data platforms, advancing cloud adoption, and establishing foundational data services that support operational excellence, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
As the Senior IT Supervisor, Data Engineering, you will drive the implementation of foundational data capabilities that support a variety of business functions. You will cultivate strategic partnerships with stakeholders to successfully implement cloud-based technologies that acquire, process, and store data across multiple latency requirements, enabling Data as a Service (DaaS) and Analytics as a Service (AaaS). You will lead delivery execution and engineering teams focused on data modernization, cloud platforms, AI-enabled solutions, and enterprise data services while advancing engineering excellence, operational reliability, and business value through scalable data solutions.  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Data, AI, and Cloud initiatives, including platform modernization, migration, integration, and analytics solutions.
* Establish engineering standards, quality controls, testing practices, and release readiness processes to ensure first-time quality delivery.
* Manage delivery plans, dependencies, risks, issues, resource allocation, and governance activities in partnership with program and project stakeholders.
