title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You will also have access to:

  

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit, an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor's degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**About Lingo**

Meet Lingo, a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers such as glucose, ketones, and lactate to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As Staff Platform Engineer at Lingo, you will spend meaningful time building and operating alongside your team, taking ownership of technically complex platform work while also being responsible for the day-to-day allocation of work, tracking and providing feedback to Platform Engineers at the India location. You set the technical standard your team works to, you unblock them when problems are hard, and you make sure they have the clarity, context, and support to do their best work.

Azure is our primary cloud platform. You will bring strong hands-on Azure expertise and apply it across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and SRE practices, while developing your two direct reports to grow in the same disciplines.

**What You'll Work On**

  

* Own the day-to-day work allocation for your team, ensuring engineers have well-scoped, meaningful work that matches their skills and develops their capabilities.
* Support your team through technical challenges, unblocking complex problems and guiding engineers toward solutions rather than solving everything yourself.
* Build, provision, and maintain Lingo's cloud infrastructure on Azure, taking ownership of technically complex or high-risk platform work alongside your team.
* Own and evolve key areas of Lingo's infrastructure-as-code foundation using Terraform or Bicep, including module design, standards, and code review for your team's contributions.
* Design and maintain CI/CD pipeline architecture for Lingo's engineering teams, defining deployment patterns, environment promotion gates, and release automation standards that your team implements and operates.
* Lead from the front on SRE practices, contributing to SLO and SLI definitions, designing alerting and monitoring configurations, and driving post-incident reviews that generate real engineering improvements.
* Build and maintain observability tooling across Lingo's production environment, covering distributed tracing, log pipelines, and metrics collection, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need.
* Partner with product and feature engineering teams to support their deployment needs, onboard them to platform tooling, and reduce friction in the path from development to production.
* Contribute to architecture and design discussions with the Platform Engineer Lead and Senior Manager, providing practical input grounded in your day-to-day operational experience.
* Document infrastructure, runbooks, and operational processes in a way that supports knowledge sharing across Lingo's globally distributed engineering team spanning the US, Spain, and India.
* Identify process, tooling, and reliability improvements within your team's domain and drive them to completion with appropriate prioritization and stakeholder communication.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering with hands-on work in a production environment.
* Strong hands-on Azure expertise, with production experience across Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, and security services.
* Solid infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent, including designing and reviewing reusable modules in a team environment.
* Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent, including deployment automation and environment promotion.
* Working understanding of SRE principles including SLOs, SLIs, alerting strategies, on-call practices, and incident response and post-incident review workflows.
* Experience with observability tooling for monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing in a cloud-native environment.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls including identity and access management, network security configurations, and secrets management.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed engineering team spanning multiple time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure-native services such as Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure Security Center in a production context.
* Experience supporting IoT, biosensor, or real-time consumer health data platforms where data reliability and low-latency processing are critical.
* Familiarity with AIOps tooling and AI-driven observability practices, including anomaly detection and automated alerting.
* Background in MLOps infrastructure, including model serving, feature stores, and pipeline orchestration on cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud security and compliance frameworks including HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI in an engineering context.
* Prior experience in a consumer technology company or high-growth digital health environment.

description:

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Unleash Your Potential

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble Health Partners India!**

Ensemble Health Partners - The single solution for a frictionless revenue cycle with the purpose of redefining the possible in healthcare by empowering people to be the difference. Our India Office is an extension of Ensemble’s team and culture designed to augment and enhance our talent and skill base in Revenue Cycle Management in addition to our long-standing presence in technology. Leveraging our platform of services, technology, business intelligence and analytics, our teams are creating and maintaining innovative products and systems to help our revenue cycle operators achieve the most efficient, ideal outcomes for our clients. Our teams are certified in revenue cycle best practices and are supporting end-to-end RCM operations. We are at the forefront of innovation using cutting-edge technology to drive meaningful impact in the Revenue Cycle Management landscape. As a leading player in the industry, we offer an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration, where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a difference.

**The Opportunity:**

**The Role:**

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to build, evaluate, and continuously improve clinical AI agents and supervised ML Models. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, LLM systems, evaluation, model improvement, and deep healthcare workflow understanding.

Your job is to turn frontier model capability into reliable production behavior: agents that read complex medical records, use the right clinical and coding context, call the right tools, produce auditable outputs, and improve from real-world failures.

You will be embedded in hard healthcare problems, clinical documentation integrity, medical coding, denial prevention, appeals, revenue cycle workflows, and payer logic — and will own the loop from problem framing to agent design, evaluation, deployment, trace analysis, and ongoing improvement.

The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who thinks like an applied scientist: rigorous about measurement, comfortable with ambiguity, excited by messy real-world data, and motivated by closing the gap between impressive demos and dependable production systems.

Most AI roles are either too research-heavy or too product-light. This role sits in the middle. You will not only write prompts or run experiments. You will own whether an agent actually works in production. That means understanding the workflow, designing the system, building the evals, inspecting failures, improving the agent, and proving that the improvement matters.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and continuously improve production AI systems for complex healthcare workflows, including documentation, coding, denial management, appeals, and revenue cycle automation.
* Prototype new AI capabilities from 0 to 1, then harden them into reliable, explainable, auditable production systems with clear contracts, monitoring, evidence, and performance gates.
* Build rigorous evaluation and feedback loops using expert review, production logs, model outputs, and benchmarks to measure performance, regressions, reliability, cost, and business impact.
* Own outcomes end to end: understand the workflow, design the system, inspect failures, improve the system, and prove that the improvement matters.
* Set technical direction for a portfolio of projects, review designs, and mentor engineers as a technical lead.
* Partner with research, ML engineering, platform, and product teams on model selection, training, infrastructure, and Productionalization.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field is a plus.

**Industry Experience**

* 5-10 years of Applied Research, ML engineering, research engineering, software engineering, or applied AI experience.
* A track record of shipping and operating production systems, ideally in ambiguous, high-stakes domains.
* Prior experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or other regulated industries is a plus, not a requirement.

**Why Choose Ensemble India?**

People First, Last + Always

We believe in putting people at the heart of everything. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth and innovation—where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured.

**A Place to Thrive**

Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.

**Comprehensive Total Rewards**

We support the physical, emotional and financial well-being of you and your family. Our Total Rewards package include:

* Healthcare coverage for associates and their immediate families including parents
* Paid time off plans

* Recognition and wellness programs
* Market competitive pay rates

Our organization is deeply committed to fostering a positive environment and culture where we celebrate and reward merit and contribution and where every associate feels valued, included, and empowered to succeed.

We proudly partner with local communities through philanthropic initiatives—from school supply drives to health awareness campaigns—because giving back is part of who we are.

title: Staff Engineer Photolithography
description:

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Photolithography Engineer at Micron, you will be responsible to tackle critical lithography scribe challenges for memory devices. This includes modeling to support optical simulation related to scribe mark, provide mark design recommendations, identifying root causes for sophisticated problems, and providing simulation training for other photolithography engineers. You will also define and lead projects to address photolithography performance gaps on current and future memory and storage nodes.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Understand the technology challenges with respect to overlay and establish project plans to address them for the N, N+1, and N+2 nodes.
* Work with vendor applications teams to find areas for overlay scribe improvement.
* Drive technical innovation in your area of expertise as a recognized Micron expert in your field.

* Define and lead sophisticated, multi-disciplinary projects that are essential to Micron’s photolithography roadmap. Help to craft strategic decisions.
* Work with process development engineers on issues and projects related to photolithography.
* Summarize plans, progress to experimental work, and conclusions in the form of written reports.
* Provide advice and counsel to senior management on technical issues related to overlay scribe.

Qualifications for this position include:

* Strong understanding of photolithography. Familiarity with semiconductor process integration is a plus.
* Understanding of optics. Understanding of the principals of photolithography and optical metrology.

* Understand various alignment and overlay marks. Understand how mark type and design can impact overlay errors. Experience with overlay mark simulation software is a plus.

title: Product Support Specialist I
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Overview:

The Product Support Specialist I is a role within the Customer Support team, supporting customers on Seismic's sales enablement platform. This is a chat-first role focused on delivering fast, friendly answers to customers via ServiceNow chat, with a goal of maintaining a Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score above 90%. The Specialist owns and resolves Q&A and how-to style chat conversations directly, while opening and routing more technical cases to Level 1 or Level 2 Support Engineers with clear context. The role also contributes to the team's shared product knowledge by identifying gaps in existing documentation and adding new or updated knowledge base content. This role will become a subject matter expert in all areas of the product in order to assist customers with questions in real time.

  

Who you are::  

* 2+ years of relevant work experience in a customer service or technical support role.
* Expected to obtain Seismic Learning or Seismic University Certifications during tenure.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Basic technical knowledge related to SaaS platforms.
* Ability to distinguish between a straightforward question and one that needs technical escalation, and to follow structured processes for each.
* Team-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to learning and contributing.
* Demonstrates reliability and consistency in handling customer interactions.
* Resolves Q&A/how-to cases efficiently while routing technical cases cleanly, with minimal back-and-forth for Support Engineers.
* Shows eagerness to learn and grow within the role and organization.
* Makes a measurable impact on customer satisfaction.
* Actively surfaces knowledge gaps and helps strengthen the team's shared product knowledge base.
* Builds strong working relationships within the team and across support tiers.

What you'll be doing::

Key Responsibilities

* Respond to customer inquiries via ServiceNow chat in a timely and professional manner.
* Own and resolve Q&A and how-to style support cases directly, end to end.
* Open cases for more technical or complex issues, and route them to a Level 1 or Level 2 Support Engineer with clear, complete context (what was tried, what the customer reported, relevant details).
* Maintain a Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score above 90%.
* Apply basic troubleshooting techniques across core Seismic product areas (e.g., LiveSend, LiveDocs, DSR, Meetings) to answer common questions and guide customers through standard how-to scenarios.
* Recognize the line between a Q&A/how-to case you can own and a technical issue that needs engineering-level troubleshooting.
* Identify gaps in existing knowledge base articles and documentation.
* Contribute new knowledge articles and article updates.
* Collaborate with Support Engineers to ensure smooth handoff and follow-up on routed cases.
* Use appropriate macros for support and escalation.
* Learn the Sev-0/Sev-1 incident response process, including recognizing when a customer issue may be part of a broader incident.
* Demonstrate initiative by contributing to side projects and team improvements.

title: Principal Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.
  + Use data and telemetry to identify AI quality gaps, generate insights, and deliver **proofs of concept** that apply research innovations to real‑world operational challenges.
  + Design robust **multi‑step reasoning and tool‑use strategies**, including function calling, code execution, APIs, and secure connectors, with strong safety and reliability guardrails.
  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**
  + Define task‑level evaluation metrics for agentic behavior, including **success rate, tool‑call accuracy, step efficiency, hallucination rate, safety violations, time‑to‑completion, and user satisfaction**.
  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design
    - A/B experimentation and telemetry‑driven iteration loops
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines and Lead Technical Execution**
  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.
  + Lead design reviews and influence engineering decisions across **agent frameworks, model integration, and system architecture**.
  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.
* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model serving/inference.
* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cloud technology Stack
* Experience with **parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning** techniques (e.g., LoRA) for LLMs or multimodal models.
* Hands‑on experience building **agentic or tool‑augmented LLM systems**, including function calling, planners, and API/tool integration.
* Experience with **advanced RAG architectures**, such as hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citation strategies.
* Strong **AIOps depth**, including quality drift detection, alerting, rollback, and telemetry‑driven optimization.
* Experience optimizing systems for **latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency** at enterprise scale.
* Prior experience working on **mission‑critical or large‑scale enterprise AI systems**.
* Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership within applied science or engineering teams.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

title: Senior Emulation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Axiado is building the future of AI powered digital infrastructure. We are a fast-growing, well funded silicon, systems, and solutions company pioneering a new category of semiconductor called the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU) that combines advanced hardware security, AI driven resilience and efficiency, and real-time platform management. Our technology protects the world’s most critical infrastructure—from data centers to next generation cloud and AI platforms—by securing systems at the foundation levels of hardware, independent of host CPUs and operating systems.

Founded in 2019 and now over 150 employees are strong, Axiado has evolved into a recognized leader in the convergence of AI, security, and silicon innovation. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long-term market trajectory. Axiado has also won numerous industry awards for our ground-breaking products and technological innovations, including being named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Security, winning the 2025 Global InfoSec Award for Outstanding AI Security Solution, and being named a finalist for the Global Semiconductor Alliance’s 2025 “Start-Up to Watch” award.

At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering—it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world.

If you’re driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey.

 **Job Description**

The Senior Emulation Engineer position is your opportunity to join one of the industry’s leading companies in platform security management and ransomware detection for cloud datacenters, 5G infrastructure and disaggregated compute ecosystems. We are looking for an emulation engineer to run and debug system-level workloads on Synopsys ZeBu emulation platforms and to own the integration and bring-up of transactors (XTORs) that connect the emulated SoC to real and virtual interfaces. Your focus is what happens once the design is running: getting the interfaces alive, executing firmware, OS, and use-case validation, triaging failures, and finding issues before silicon. This role is critical for validating the interoperability of our design with commercial AI servers, and for bridging the gap between hardware and software, as well as supporting SW development.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**Runtime validation**

* Execute and debug system-level tests, firmware, and software workloads on ZeBu emulation models
* Bring up and validate secure boot flows (ROM, bootloader, Linux/RTOS) and platform security features such as root of trust, attestation, and firmware update on the emulated SoC
* Develop and run use-case scenarios covering platform security management, ransomware detection workloads, and datacenter/5G traffic patterns
* Triage failures and isolate root cause across RTL, firmware, driver, testbench, XTOR, and emulation environment; produce clear, reproducible bug reports
* Use ZeBu runtime debug capabilities (waveform capture, triggers, memory/register access, checkpoint/restore, force/release) to debug efficiently at speed
* Run and manage long-running regressions and soak tests; track pass rates, failure trends, and run-to-run stability
* Perform power-aware and performance validation runs: activity capture, bandwidth/latency profiling, and use-case benchmarking

**XTOR integration and bring-up**

* Integrate and configure ZeBu transactors and speed adapters (PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, NVMe, DDR/LPDDR, I2C/I3C/SMBus, SPI, UART, JTAG, etc.) at the testbench and runtime level
* Bring up XTOR-to-DUT links from first connectivity through link training, enumeration, and stable data traffic; resolve protocol-level and configuration issues
* Develop host-side software and drivers that control XTORs (C/C++, Python, SystemVerilog DPI, ZeBu API), including connections to real devices, virtual peripherals, or hybrid platforms
* Debug XTOR-related failures using protocol analyzers, waveforms, and logs; determine whether the issue lies in the DUT, the XTOR, clocking/speed-adapter configuration, or the host
* Tune XTOR configuration for throughput, latency, and emulation-frequency compatibility
* Maintain XTOR configuration, version control, and documentation across model releases
* Configure host servers, boot environments to interact with the emulated design
* Integrate, develop and debug transactors, bridges and protocol adapters as needed
* Debug and root-cause embedded HW, SW and test failures in emulation
* Collaborate with RTL, DV and SW teams to resolve system level bugs

 **Qualifications**

* BS or MS degrees or higher in EE, CE or related fields
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in prototyping, emulation, SOC design and validation
* Self-driven, good problem solving and communication skills
* Hands-on experience running and debugging designs on Synopsys ZeBu (or comparable emulators such as Palladium or Veloce), including runtime control (NGTB or C based), waveform capture, and checkpoint/restore
* Experience integrating and debugging high-speed and low-speed interfaces
* Familiarity with embedded software bring-up and bootloader/kernel interactions
* Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL) for automation
* Preferred qualifications include: experience in design verification, hardware/software co-simulation, Linux device drivers, bare-metal FW or boot loaders

 **Additional Information**

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled Network & DNS Design Engineer to join our Network Engineering team. This role is responsible for the design, governance, automation and L3 support of enterprise DNS, domain management and core network services across cloud, datacentre and corporate environments.

The successful candidate will be a subject matter expert in DNS technologies including AWS Route53, Microsoft Active Directory-integrated DNS and BIND, with responsibility for ensuring the availability, security and scalability of critical name resolution services supporting both internal users and customer-facing platforms.

* Own the design and governance of public and private DNS infrastructure, including hosted zones, delegation, forwarding, conditional forwarding and resolver services.

* Manage the organisation's domain portfolio, including registrations, renewals, transfers, security controls and lifecycle governance.

* Strong experience with BIND DNS administration and architecture.

* Deep understanding of DNS protocols, DNSSEC, recursive and authoritative DNS services.

* Experience managing enterprise domain portfolios and registrar relationships.

title: Embedded Software Technical Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Embedded Software Technical Lead**, you will lead the implementation and delivery of assigned firmware modules and workstreams for Kandou's new ASIC products, under the technical direction of the overall Firmware Lead. You will remain hands-on in coding, debugging and bring-up, while mentoring engineers working on your scope. The overall Firmware Lead owns the firmware roadmap, team-wide priorities and release decisions; this role owns execution within the agreed architecture and project plan.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the design, development, test and maintenance of assigned real-time firmware modules for high-speed heterogeneous SoC platforms.
* Translate agreed system requirements into module designs and hardware/software interfaces; review architecture and interface changes with the Firmware Lead and architects.
* Plan and coordinate assigned work: estimate effort, track dependencies and milestones, and escalate risks and priority conflicts to the Firmware Lead.
* Remain hands-on in C/C++ development, RTOS integration, low-level drivers, bootloaders, secure boot and reliable firmware updates.
* Drive bring-up, hardware/software integration and root-cause analysis for assigned firmware, working with silicon design and validation teams.
* Lead module-level design and code reviews, apply team coding and test standards, and provide validation evidence and documentation for firmware release reviews.
* Mentor engineers on assigned work, guide implementation decisions and share knowledge; align broader technical decisions with the Firmware Lead.

Coordinate with validation and applications teams to resolve integration and field issues; improve the software tools supporting silicon development and debug.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of experience designing, coding and debugging real-time embedded applications in C and/or C++, including 2+ years providing technical leadership for firmware modules or projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of firmware module delivery from requirements and design through bring-up, validation and release integration within a wider engineering team.
* Strong embedded SoC experience with bare-metal and RTOS environments, including RTOS porting and integration with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and hands-on bare-metal or RTOS firmware development for RV32/RV64 cores, including trap handling, CSR access and toolchain setup.
* Board and SoC bring-up using JTAG and other debug mechanisms; ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, drivers and hardware.
* Experience interfacing with hardware and peripherals using SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C and JTAG, and implementing bootloaders, secure boot and firmware update flows.
* Proficiency in Python or another modern scripting language, and practical use of Git/GitLab, CI, Make/CMake and automated unit and integration testing.
* Strong design-review, documentation, organisational, presentation and mentoring skills; ability to align cross-functional teams and learn new technical areas.

**Useful Experience**

* Heterogeneous multicore systems with scalar and vector processors; embedded Linux, memory and network interfaces, and virtual memory.
* High-speed signalling technologies such as PCIe and CXL, including link training, equalization and retimer/redriver interaction with host and device PHYs.
* Firmware for Active Electrical Cable (AEC) or retimer/redriver ASICs, including cable diagnostics, eye margin monitoring, temperature/voltage telemetry and power-state management.
* Management and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C, MCTP and CMIS; SerDes technology and PHY register-level tuning.
* Simulation, co-simulation and FPGA platforms for pre-silicon firmware development; HyperBus and HyperRAM technologies.

Cryptographic algorithms and secure firmware lifecycle practices, including authenticated updates, recovery and rollback protection.

If this is the role you have been looking for and you want to be part of a growing Company, with an exciting future then we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!!

title: Senior Payroll Specialist (APAC)
description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

### **The role**

The Senior Payroll Specialist-APAC owns end-to-end payroll for the company's APAC entities and plays a hands-on role in US payroll; both regions are core to the role. This role harmonizes, simplifies, and continuously improves payroll execution and payroll accounting across the region's countries, entities, pay groups, payroll providers, and systems. This is to make sure payroll remains accurate, compliant, trusted, and understandable as the company grows in APAC without a proportional increase in manual work or risk. The role works alongside the US payroll owner on pay cycles, employment tax compliance, year-end, and controls, and provides full continuity during peak periods and absences.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Own end-to-end payroll execution for the company's APAC entities across countries, pay groups, and payroll providers; define consistent execution standards that meet each jurisdiction's statutory and employment requirements.
* Ensure statutory compliance across APAC jurisdictions: income tax withholding, social security and provident fund contributions, employer levies, monthly and annual statutory filings and employee tax certificates, new-country and new-entity registrations, and timely resolution of authority notices.
* Administer regulated and complex pay items accurately: statutory bonuses and gratuity, leave encashment, full-and-final settlements, equity income (RSU/option) taxation, benefits deductions, taxable perquisites, and expatriate or cross-border arrangements.
* Support US payroll execution alongside the US payroll owner: process and review multistate pay cycles and off-cycle payments, own assigned workstreams in the US payroll calendar, share year-end delivery (W-2 season), and provide full continuity during peak periods and absences.
* Drive process harmonization and simplification across APAC countries to reduce manual steps, handoffs, rework, and off-cycle runs.
* Lead payroll execution during transitions (new country or entity launches, vendor changes, system changes, restructures/M&A), ensuring continuity and control.
* Ensure payroll accounting remains clean as scope changes: consistent journals, accruals, reversals, and reconciliation standards across entities and currencies.
* Monitor preventative controls by design, including SOX-aligned payroll controls; improve evidence pack quality and audit readiness.
* Govern payroll providers against agreed SLAs and KPIs; drive remediation where service quality falls short.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring payroll, accounting, or service failures; design and implement durable fixes.
* Act as escalation owner for complex or sensitive pay issues in the region; provide authoritative explanations to senior stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Ops, Finance, Legal/Compliance, benefits providers, and payroll vendors to deliver scalable operating models and service quality.
* Provide training and guidance to new team joiners when needed.

**We expect you to have:**

* 7+ years of payroll experience spanning APAC and US payrolls, including multi-country scope with in-country providers in complex environments (growth, change, or hybrid in-house/outsourced models).
* Deep working knowledge of payroll and employment-tax compliance across APAC jurisdictions, including India: statutory withholding and social contributions, statutory bonuses and terminations, year-end reporting, and expatriate/cross-border considerations.
* Working knowledge of US payroll fundamentals (multi-state withholding, FICA/FUTA/SUI, W-2 year-end) and readiness to act as the designated US backup, including overlap with US working hours when covering.
* Strong payroll controllership skills: ability to design controls, enforce SoD/approvals, and ensure audit-ready evidence.
* Proven capability improving payroll processes (standardization, automation enablement, reducing manual effort and errors).
* Strong payroll accounting knowledge, including multi-currency environments, and experience working with Finance during close and audits.
* Demonstrated ability to lead transitions (vendor/system/new country or entity) with structured planning and issue resolution.
* Excellent stakeholder management across time zones and cultures; comfortable acting as an escalation owner and payroll authority.

**It will be an added bonus if you have:**

* Hands-on experience with multi-country payroll platforms or aggregators and their HRIS/GL integrations.
* Experience operating payroll controls in a SOX-compliant, US-listed company environment.
* Hands-on US payroll processing experience, ideally in a shared-services or follow-the-sun support model. Knowledge and experience with US statutory requirements at Federal, State and local levels
* Experience with payroll operating models and vendor governance (SLAs, KPIs, remediation).
* Experience turning statutory/operational requirements into system/workflow requirements.
* Project management certification or comparable experience leading cross-functional initiatives.

#### **Competencies & Behavioral Traits:**

* Systems thinking: redesigns the process so it scales, rather than adding checks and manual work.
* Bias for prevention: anticipates issues and builds guardrails.
* Influence without authority; can align multiple stakeholders and vendors around standards.

title: Firmware Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Firmware Lead**, you will lead implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for Kandou's Randa 1.6T Active Electrical Cable platform. This is a coding-heavy technical leadership role: you will spend the majority of your time writing and reviewing C/C++, debugging firmware and hardware interactions, and supporting pre-silicon and post-silicon bring-up. You will turn the Firmware Architect's system design into production code, own implementation quality and delivery, and mentor engineers while remaining active in the codebase.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for AEC retimer silicon across 224G/lane, 448G/lane and forward-looking 896G/lane configurations; remain a hands-on C/C++ contributor.
* Implement and maintain boot, configuration, calibration, link-training, fault-recovery and run-time supervision state machines on resource-constrained RISC-V or ARM platforms.
* Translate approved firmware architecture into module designs, APIs, task and interrupt models, memory budgets and hardware/software contracts; surface implementation tradeoffs early.
* Code, debug and optimize firmware for SerDes equalization and adaptation, FEC-aware monitoring and re-adaptation, telemetry capture, thermal behavior and power management.
* Own low-level drivers and management interfaces including SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C, MCTP and JTAG, and integrate firmware services with the CMIS management layer.
* Drive pre-silicon development and first-silicon bring-up; isolate issues across firmware, RTL, boards and lab setups using JTAG, register traces and targeted instrumentation.
* Set coding and review standards; build unit, integration and hardware-in-loop tests; enforce CI, static analysis and release evidence; improve Python-based build, debug and test tools.
* Break the roadmap into deliverable work packages, estimate and track execution, mentor firmware engineers and coordinate with architecture, ASIC, DV, validation, SI and applications teams.

**Essential Experience**

* 8+ years developing and debugging production real-time firmware in C/C++, including 2+ years leading firmware modules, projects or a small team.
* Expert hands-on C/C++ in resource-constrained systems, with recent evidence of personal code delivery, code review and complex defect resolution.
* Firmware experience on a retimer, gearbox, PHY, AEC, AOC, optical module, networking ASIC or comparable high-speed mixed hardware/software product.
* RISC-V and/or ARM bare-metal or RTOS firmware, including interrupts, traps, CSR or register access, concurrency and tight RAM/flash budgets.
* RTOS development with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent; ownership of scheduling, synchronization, timing and failure recovery.
* At least one silicon or board bring-up cycle using JTAG and related debug mechanisms, with root-cause analysis across firmware, drivers, RTL and hardware.
* Python, Git/GitLab, Make/CMake, CI, unit and integration testing, and static analysis, with disciplined reproducible development workflows.

BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience; strong communication, planning, mentoring and cross-functional leadership.

**Useful experience**

* IEEE 802.3ck or 802.3dj link training and equalization, SerDes adaptation algorithms, channel-quality monitoring and register-level PHY tuning.
* FEC exposure including KP4 or RS-544, pre-FEC and post-FEC telemetry, symbol-error analysis and FEC-aware recovery behavior.
* CMIS 5.x firmware integration, module or datapath state machines, VDM telemetry, and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C and MCTP.
* Bootloaders, secure boot, root of trust, authenticated A/B firmware updates, rollback protection and field-recovery mechanisms.
* Pre-silicon firmware development using QEMU, SystemC, FPGA, simulation or emulation; heterogeneous multicore or vector-processing systems.

PCIe or CXL, hyperscaler qualification, interoperability debugging, and production support for field or manufacturing issues.

If this is the role you have been looking for and you want to be part of a growing Company, with an exciting future then we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!!

title: Senior MLOps Consultant (Databricks)
description:
**Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer (Databricks)**

Chryselys is looking for a Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer with strong experience in Databricks to run the machine learning lifecycle from experiment to production.

You will set up Databricks environments, turn notebooks into scheduled jobs, and package and deploy models with consistent runtimes, versioning, and monitoring. You will work with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders in healthcare and pharmaceutical domains.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set up and maintain Databricks for ML: workspaces, clusters, instance pools, cluster policies, Repos, and runtime versions.
* Provide notebook and job templates, shared libraries, and pinned environments so experiments can be repeated.
* Build CI/CD to promote notebooks, jobs, workflows, and models across development, staging, and production environments using Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps, with Databricks Asset Bundles or the Jobs and Repos APIs.
* Track, package, register, and deploy models with MLflow on Databricks, including batch scoring and model serving jobs.
* Build Databricks Workflows for training, retraining, evaluation, and inference, with task dependencies, retries, and alerts.
* Support classification, forecasting as Python and Spark jobs on Databricks.
* Tune cluster size, autoscaling, Spark settings, and Delta Lake reads and writes so jobs stay reliable and cost-efficient.
* Convert Data Scientist notebooks into production pipelines with clear inputs, outputs, and fixed dependencies.
* Apply Databricks controls: Unity Catalog for data and model access, secret scopes, service principals, and model versioning.
* Fix failed jobs, slow Spark runs, library conflicts, and environment differences across workspaces.
* Write standards and runbooks for workspace layout, cluster policies, job templates, and promotion from dev to production.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6–12 years in ML Engineering, MLOps, or platform engineering, including hands-on ML work on Databricks.
* Databricks experience with workspaces, clusters and policies, Jobs and Workflows, Repos, Delta Lake, and Spark (batch and streaming).
* MLflow on Databricks for experiment tracking, model packaging, and the model registry.
* Strong Python, plus working knowledge of PySpark or Spark SQL.
* CI/CD for Databricks with Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience deploying ML models on Databricks, Azure, AWS services.
* Clear debugging skills and the ability to work with data science and platform teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform, or workspace-as-code.
* Unity Catalog, cluster policies, and service principals for job runs.
* Azure ML services such as Azure Machine Learning and Amazon SageMaker for training, pipelines, or model deployment.
* Healthcare or pharmaceutical domain experience.
* Agile or Scrum.
* Python packaging on Databricks (pip or conda, and runtime libraries).

**Good to Have:**

* SQL and PySpark for reading, joining, and transforming data on Databricks.
* Simple pipelines that ingest data, clean it, and store it in Delta Lake.
* Data quality checks and schema handling.
* Familiarity with healthcare or pharma data, such as EHR, clinical, or patient and drug datasets.
* Docker for packaging jobs and model services.
* Kubernetes and KServe for deploying and scaling models.
* Helm, Kubeflow, or Seldon for model deployment.
* MLflow, GitHub Actions, and Terraform for tracking, CI/CD, and environment setup.
* Model performance monitoring, data drift detection, alerting, and rollback for production models.

title: Job Posting Title Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


What You’ll Do


Lead software architecture and modernization


Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well\-structured, domain\-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.


Stay deeply hands\-on in code


Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.


Design strong domain models and APIs


Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.


Modernize application foundations


Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.


Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability


Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.


Improve data access and integration design


Move business logic out of database\-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event\-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.


Raise the bar for code quality and testing


Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.


Create reusable engineering patterns


Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.


Turn technical strategy into cross\-team execution


Translate architectural risk into clear code\-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.


What This Is Not


This is not a people\-management or architecture\-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.


This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long\-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.


What You Bring


Deep backend and distributed\-systems engineering


You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.


Credible hands\-on implementation depth


You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.


Service transformation and architecture judgment


You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.


Production reliability and performance expertise


You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.


Software design and refactoring depth


You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.


Data and integration depth


You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.


Strong testing and code\-quality discipline


You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.


Principal\-level technical leadership


You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.


An opportunity\-focused approach to AI\-assisted engineering


You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.


Bonus Points


Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.


Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.


Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.


Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database\-performance diagnosis, or tuning.


Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.


What Success Looks Like


Modernization advances without destabilizing the business


Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.


Critical software becomes easier to change


Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.


Architecture decisions become executable


Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross\-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.


Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle


Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.


AI expands engineering leverage


AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.


Why This Matters


ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.


This role connects long\-term technical direction with hands\-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.

title: AI Reimagination Engineer
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi\-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Decompose end\-to\-end processes: Map current\-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
* Architect the agentic solution: Build future\-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data\-classification standards.
* Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
* Engineer trust and control: Define testable human\-in\-the\-loop controls and least\-privilege permissions for each process step.
* Drive multi\-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
* Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90\-day post\-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
* Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
* Agentic Delivery: 8\+ years of overall experience and 3\+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop\-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible\-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
* Technical Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C\#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi\-agent development, context management, and long\-horizon tasks.
* Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.

This role focuses on shaping AI architecture strategy and solution patterns that drive operational efficiency, improve user experiences, reduce risk, and generate measurable business and revenue value. We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment with significant opportunities for growth.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define enterprise AI architecture standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures, and engineering guardrails

* Architect and guide development of an AI lab for experimentation, prototyping, evaluation, model testing, and rapid iteration
* Define and operationalize AI\-DLC practices, including experimentation, evaluation, governance, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement
* Design reusable and scalable AI platforms, services, APIs, orchestration patterns, and integration layers
* Partner with business and technology leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI use cases that drive operational efficiency and measurable business value
* Define architecture patterns for GenAI capabilities such as RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool calling, memory management, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows
* Architect AI agent ecosystems, tool integrations, and orchestration workflows across enterprise platforms and systems
* Provide technical direction on LLMs, SLMs, embeddings, vector search, model APIs, model selection, and AI service integration
* Create architecture blueprints, technical designs, reusable frameworks, decision records, and implementation standards
* Ensure AI solutions are secure, observable, maintainable, compliant, and aligned to enterprise architecture principles
* Establish and enforce AI governance practices, including responsible AI, data protection, privacy, compliance, auditability, and risk controls
* Guide deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational readiness of AI applications and platforms
* Define evaluation frameworks, quality benchmarks, feedback loops, and AI performance measurement approaches
* Partner with stakeholders to move AI ideas from concept through architecture, experimentation, production, and scale
* Mentor engineers, architects, and product teams on AI\-native architecture, AI engineering practices, and responsible AI solution design
* Influence technology selection and platform strategy across AWS, Azure, AI\-native PaaS services, agent frameworks, observability tools, and enterprise integration patterns

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, and/or AI architecture experience
* 8\+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud\-native solutions using modern architecture patterns
* Strong programming background, preferably with Python, and ability to guide architecture for Python\-based AI services and applications
* Hands\-on experience architecting or building AI\-enabled applications, GenAI solutions, AI agents, or AI platforms
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure, including AI\-native PaaS cloud services such as AWS Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure OpenAI
* Strong understanding of GenAI architecture patterns, including:


	+ LLM/SLM model selection
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation — RAG
	+ Prompt engineering and evaluation
	+ Agentic workflows
	+ Tool/function calling
	+ Embeddings and vector search
	+ Human\-in\-the\-loop systems
	+ AI observability and monitoring
	+ Model evaluation and quality benchmarking
* Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies
* Experience with LLM ecosystems and providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral, or similar model providers
* Experience with vector databases and retrieval systems such as Pinecone, Azure AI Search, or equivalent technologies
* Experience with tool, agent, and UI interoperability patterns, including AG\-UI, A2A, MCP, registries, and reusable service layers
* Experience integrating APIs, microservices, event\-driven systems, and enterprise platforms into AI workflows
* Strong understanding of modern architecture patterns including microservices, APIs, event\-driven systems, cloud services, serverless patterns, and platform\-based architectures
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and partnering with product, engineering, operations, security, and compliance teams
* Strong understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, privacy, compliance, and risk management considerations
* Ability to translate business problems into scalable AI architecture, reusable solution patterns, and implementation roadmaps
* Strong analytical, communication, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills
* Self\-starter with the ability to lead through ambiguity, influence technical direction, and collaborate across teams

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building, leading, or contributing to an AI Center of Excellence, AI platform team, AI innovation team, or enterprise AI enablement function
* Experience defining or implementing an AI Development Lifecycle — AI\-DLC
* Experience designing structured Context Engineering practices to improve model reliability, consistency, traceability, and performance
* Experience with observability and evaluation tools such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, CloudWatch, LangSmith, or similar platforms
* CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure automation, and cloud deployment patterns
* Architecting AI solutions in regulated, compliance\-driven, or risk\-sensitive environments
* Experience delivering AI solutions for operational automation, customer experience, internal productivity, or revenue\-generating products.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or similar standards
* Experience defining reusable architecture patterns for multi\-agent orchestration, deterministic workflows, human review, policy enforcement, auditability, and production monitoring
* Experience creating executive\-level architecture artifacts, technology roadmaps, solution blueprints, and governance models

**AI Mindset:**

* Balance rapid experimentation with disciplined architecture, governance, and engineering practices
* Design AI platforms and solutions for scalability, reusability, observability, security, and compliance from the start
* Focus on measurable business outcomes, operational impact, risk reduction, and value creation
* Embrace ambiguity while helping define standards, patterns, and guardrails for emerging AI capabilities
* Build systems with continuous evaluation, monitoring, feedback, and improvement
* Apply responsible AI principles across architecture, design, deployment, and operations
* Promote reusable AI patterns that accelerate delivery while reducing duplication, inconsistency, and operational risk
* Think in terms of platforms, ecosystems, agent interoperability, reusable tools, and enterprise\-scale adoption

**Working Conditions:**

* The company environment is dynamic and reflective of rapid growth
* Friendly, helpful, open, and all inclusive
* Fast paced with frequent changes
